description:
UX/UI Designer for Web and Mobile App Redesign


We are looking for a talented UX/UI designer to refresh and update the look of our website's search page, author pages, and category pages. These pages share similar designs with minor differences. Additionally, we need designs for a mobile app.


Project Scope:

Redesign the search page, author pages, and category pages with a modern and cohesive look.

Create a mobile app design that aligns with the refreshed website aesthetics.


Search Page Redesign:

Maintain the current color scheme.

Remove the various article categories on the right side.

Add a filters section to the left side. This will include categories, patient gender, publication date, and potentially other fields.

Article results should maintain the same styling.


Author Pages and Category Pages:

Ensure a consistent look and feel with the redesigned search page.

Maintain intuitive navigation and user-friendly interfaces.


Mobile App Design:

Provide a user-friendly design that mirrors the updated website aesthetics.

Ensure a seamless user experience on mobile devices.


What We Need From You:

Examples of your previous UX/UI design work, particularly any projects related to web and mobile applications.

A prototype design for the search page based on the requirements listed above.


You will be asked to answer the following questions when submitting a proposal:

  1. Please provide a prototype design of the search page.

description:
We are looking for a skilled frontend developer to assist us in building a users page for our web platform. You will be responsible for implementing the design provided by our UI/UX team and ensuring seamless functionality across different devices and browsers. The ideal candidate should have experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web design. Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to work collaboratively are crucial for this role.


Skills:

- HTML

- CSS

- JavaScript

- Responsive Web Design

- UI/UX Design Integration


Background:

The Nova Slides platform requires a comprehensive user management system that allows admins to efficiently manage all users on the platform. The goal of this project is to develop a "Manage Users" page that displays detailed user information in a table format, provides functionalities to edit user details, and offers options to reset passwords, deactivate/reactivate accounts, and delete users.


The current development team is using Tailwind for the component library, and using React and Firebase to build the frontend and backend.


Deliverables:

Backend System: A system to handle user data management, including storing and retrieving user details, and performing user-related actions (edit, reset password, deactivate/reactivate, delete).

Frontend / User Interface: A web-based interface displaying a table of users with various user management actions.

Documentation: Comprehensive documentation including implementation details, technical constraints, and user guides.

**Job Title:** Website Design and Rebranding Specialist for Luxury Candle Company


**Job Description:**


EnerLight Candle Company seeks a highly skilled and creative website design and rebranding specialist to elevate our online presence. Our brand is synonymous with elegance, luxury, and sophistication, and we cater to the spa and wellness industries, affluent individuals, and the urban chic community. We need a professional who can bring our vision to life and ensure our website reflects the high-end nature of our products.


**Responsibilities:**


- Update and redesign our current website to create an appealing and luxurious look and feel.

- Ensure the website visually appeals to our target audiences: spa and wellness industries, affluent individuals, and the urban chic community.

- Incorporate our brand colors, providing color codes that will be interchangeable with our upcoming product lines, including charcuterie, tea, foam soap, and room and body sprays.

- Enhance the user experience with intuitive navigation and a visually striking design.

- Understand and integrate the urban flavor and unique style that our CEO embodies.

- Ensure consistency across all branding elements, maintaining an upscale, high-class aesthetic.


**Qualifications:**


- Proven experience in website design and branding for luxury brands.

- Strong understanding of the spa, wellness, and high-income markets.

- Ability to create designs that appeal to affluent and urban chic audiences.

- Expertise in color theory and branding, with the ability to provide interchangeable color codes for various product lines.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate closely with our team.

- Portfolio showcasing previous work on high-end, luxury brands.


**To Apply:**


Please submit your resume, portfolio, and a brief cover letter explaining how your experience and skills make you the perfect fit for this project. We look forward to seeing your creative vision for EnerLight Candle Company!

description:
Shopify website builder


Are you a creative Shopify Website Designer with a passion for creating compelling e-commerce experiences? We are looking for a versatile professional who can design and develop Shopify stores, implement effective funnels, and collaborate effectively within a team environment.


Responsibilities:


Design and develop Shopify stores, incorporating branding, user experience best practices, and responsive design principles.

Customize Shopify themes and templates using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify's Liquid templating language to meet client or company requirements.

Create and optimize sales funnels within Shopify to maximize conversion rates and enhance user journeys.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams including marketers, developers, and content creators to integrate design requirements with technical specifications.

Conduct usability tests and gather feedback from stakeholders to continuously improve website design and funnel performance.

Stay updated with Shopify platform updates, new features, and industry trends to propose innovative solutions.


Requirements:


Proven experience in Shopify website design and development, including customization of themes and templates.

Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify's Liquid templating language.

Experience in designing and optimizing sales funnels, including landing pages, checkout flows, and email sequences.

Strong understanding of user experience (UX) principles and best practices in e-commerce.

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Portfolio showcasing previous Shopify store designs and funnels developed, demonstrating creativity and technical skills.


Benefits:


Opportunity to work in a collaborative environment with a supportive team dedicated to innovation and growth.

Competitive compensation package with benefits and opportunities for professional development.

Flexible work arrangements and a culture that values work-life balance.

If you are passionate about e-commerce design, have a knack for creating visually appealing and functional Shopify stores, and thrive in a team-oriented environment, we encourage you to apply.

description:
here is description:


Project Overview for Designer: This project involves the development of a software solution for managing tenant electricity projects, with a focus on providing comprehensive, efficient, and user-friendly features. The solution will cater to landlords, tenants, and administrators, enabling them to monitor energy consumption, manage billing, and facilitate communication. Below are the detailed user stories and wireframe requirements for each feature.


User Stories and Wireframe Requirements


1. Dashboard with Widgets


User Story:


  • As a landlord, I want a customizable dashboard with widgets to analyze and monitor energy consumption, so I can manage usage efficiently.
  • As a tenant, I want to view specific widgets related to my energy consumption, so I can monitor my usage and billing.


Wireframes:


  • Landlord Dashboard: Widget selection, energy consumption charts, alerts section.
  • Tenant Dashboard: Limited widget view, personal energy consumption.


2. API Integration


User Story:


  • As a developer, I want to integrate an API to retrieve data from the energy meters, so the system can process and display real-time data.


Wireframes:


  • API Setup Page: Endpoint configuration, authentication setup.
  • Data Display: Real-time data visualization.


3. CMS Drupal


User Story:


  • As an administrator, I want to use Drupal CMS to manage user interfaces and content, so I can easily update and maintain the platform.


Wireframes:


  • Admin Interface: Content management, user role settings.
  • User Interface: Content display, role-based access.


4. Monitoring


User Story:


  • As a landlord, I want to monitor energy consumption on different levels, so I can optimize energy usage across the property.


Wireframes:


  • Monitoring Dashboard: Energy consumption charts at unit, house, and area levels.
  • Alerts Section: Notifications for unusual consumption patterns.


5. Data Archiving


User Story:


  • As an administrator, I want to archive data for a configurable duration, so long-term analysis is possible without overloading the database.


Wireframes:


  • Archiving Settings: Duration configuration, data management interface.
  • Archived Data Access: Search and filter options for archived data.


6. Real-Time Data


User Story:


  • As a tenant, I want to view real-time energy consumption data, so I can react to changes immediately.


Wireframes:


  • Real-Time Data Display: Live charts, data update intervals.
  • Integration with Alerts: Immediate notifications for specific thresholds.


7. Tenant Access


User Story:


  • As a tenant, I want a login to view my energy consumption and billing details, so I can manage my usage and payments.


Wireframes:


  • Tenant Login Page: Authentication interface.
  • Tenant Dashboard: Personal energy data, billing history.


8. Automated Billing


User Story:


  • As an administrator, I want to automate the billing process based on energy consumption, so tenants receive accurate and timely bills.


Wireframes:


  • Billing Setup: Configuration of billing cycles and rules.
  • Billing History: Access to past bills, download options.


9. Payment Tracking


User Story:


  • As a landlord, I want to track payments and outstanding amounts, so I can manage my finances effectively.


Wireframes:


  • Payment Dashboard: Overview of payments received and pending.
  • Payment Details: Individual transaction records.


10. Mobile App


User Story:


  • As a landlord, I want a mobile app to access key functions and data on the go, so I can manage the property remotely.


Wireframes:


  • Mobile Dashboard: Key metrics, alerts, and notifications.
  • Detailed Views: Access to full dashboards and reports.


Wireframe Summary

This project will require detailed wireframes for each feature to ensure all user stories and their acceptance criteria are fully addressed. Below is a summary of the wireframes needed:


  • Landlord Dashboard
  • Tenant Dashboard
  • API Setup Page
  • Monitoring Dashboard
  • Archiving Settings
  • Real-Time Data Display
  • Tenant Login Page
  • Billing Setup
  • Payment Dashboard
  • Mobile Dashboard


These wireframes will provide a comprehensive visualization of the software’s functionality and user interactions, ensuring a clear understanding of the development requirements.

description:
Shopify Web Designer


Hi,


I hope this message finds you well.


I am reaching out to request your expertise in designing a high-converting Shopify store for my dropshipping business. Below is a brief outlining the key elements and objectives I am looking for in the design:


---


**Objective:**

To create a high-converting Shopify store optimized for dropshipping, with a focus on user experience, aesthetic appeal, and streamlined functionality to drive sales and customer satisfaction.


**Key Elements:**


1. **User-Friendly Design:**

   - Clean, modern, and visually appealing layout.

   - Easy navigation with a clear menu structure.

   - Mobile-responsive design for optimal viewing on all devices.


2. **Conversion-Focused Homepage:**

   - Eye-catching hero banner with a strong call-to-action (CTA).

   - Featured products or bestsellers prominently displayed.

   - Trust signals such as customer reviews, testimonials, and security badges.

   - Imported positive reviews to build trust and credibility.


3. **Product Pages:**

   - High-quality images with zoom-in capability.

   - Detailed product descriptions highlighting benefits and features.

   - Clear pricing, availability, and shipping information.

   - Easy-to-find and compelling CTAs (e.g., “Add to Cart”, “Buy Now”).


4. **Checkout Process:**

   - Simplified, minimal steps for checkout to reduce cart abandonment.

   - Multiple payment options (credit card, PayPal, etc.).

   - Clear progress indicators during the checkout process.


5. **Site Speed and Performance:**

   - Fast loading times to improve user experience and SEO.

   - Optimized images and minimal use of heavy scripts.


6. **SEO and Content:**

   - SEO-friendly URLs, titles, and meta descriptions.

   - Engaging blog or content section to drive organic traffic.

   - Proper use of headings, alt texts, and keywords.


7. **Customer Support and Engagement:**

   - Live chat functionality or easy-to-find contact information.

   - Integration with email marketing tools for newsletters and promotions.

   - Clear return and refund policy.


8. **Email and SMS Marketing:**

   - Strategies to build our email and SMS lists for marketing purposes.

   - Integration with email and SMS marketing tools.

   - Offering discounts, sales, and prizes to encourage sign-ups and repeat purchases.


9. **Preliminary Mockup Page:**

   - Creation of a preliminary mockup page to test product mockups for five pet supplements.

   - Analysis of which product gets the most conversions for further focus and optimization.


10. **Analytics and Tracking:**

    - Integration with Google Analytics and Facebook Pixel.

    - Easy access to sales and traffic reports for ongoing optimization.


**Additional Features:**

- Integration with social media platforms.

- Loyalty programs or discount codes.

- Automated order processing and inventory management.


**Visual and Functional Inspirations:**

- Examples of successful dropshipping stores or competitors.

- Specific color schemes, fonts, and design elements to match brand identity.


---


Please use this brief as a guideline to develop a Shopify store that is not only aesthetically pleasing but also designed to maximize conversions and enhance the customer shopping experience.


Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to working with you to create a fantastic Shopify store.


Best regards,

- Look professional and modern

description:
We are looking for a skilled fullstack developer to help develop our AI-driven coaching and productivity app, Visualise. This project involves creating an app that integrates AI coaching, visualized to-do lists, habit tracking, and inspirational features. The app screens and brand guidelines are mostly complete, and you will be collaborating with me (the founder), my partner (the technical lead), and our branding and design partner.


Project Requirements:

Platform: React Native

Deployment: iOS (initially) with potential for Android in the future

App Store Readiness: Fully functional and ready for download, including payment gateway integration and discount codes


Key Responsibilities:

Collaborate with the founder, technical lead, and branding/design partner

Develop the app in React Native, ensuring it meets our specifications and guidelines

Implement AI-driven features using ChatGPT APIs and other necessary technologies

Integrate visualized to-do lists, habit tracking, and inspirational photo features

Ensure seamless synchronization with Google Calendar and other calendar platforms

Set up and test the payment gateway and discount code functionality

Ensure the app is fully functional and ready for submission to the App Store


Key Requirements:

Experience: Proven experience with React Native development, including deployment on iOS

AI Integration: Experience with chatbots and AI tools, particularly ChatGPT or similar

Complex Connections: Ability to manage complex structures and integrations driven by AI


Communication: Strong English skills, both written and verbal

Paid Apps: Preferably, experience with paid apps currently available in the market


Budget and Milestones:

Budget: +/- $5,000 USD

Ongoing collaboration possible.

Milestones: Payments will be made with a 50% deposit, with the balance payable upon delivery of each milestone. The final milestone includes the app being ready for download on the App Store.


Preferred Candidates:

Experience with chatbots and AI tools

Proven track record of creating structured, complex applications

Excellent English communication skills

Experience with successful paid apps in the market

If you are passionate about leveraging AI to create impactful coaching and productivity tools and have the expertise to bring our vision to life, we would love to hear from you. Please provide examples of your previous work, particularly any relevant projects that demonstrate your capabilities in AI integration and complex app development.


How to Apply:

Submit your proposal, including your resume, portfolio, and a brief description of your experience with similar projects. Highlight any specific experience with React Native, AI tools, and paid app development. We look forward to collaborating with you to make Visualise a success.

description:
About Hatchproof:﻿


Hatchproof is revolutionizing the future of work through innovative technology that leverages behavioral science and AI to enhance employee retention and organizational alignment. Join us in our mission to create a more harmonious and productive workforce.


Role Overview:


We are looking for a talented and passionate Front End Developer to join our dynamic team. As a Front End Developer at Hatchproof, you will be responsible for crafting high-quality, user-friendly web interfaces that enhance our platform's functionality and user experience. You will work closely with our design and development teams to turn ideas into compelling digital experiences.


Key Responsibilities:


Develop and maintain responsive, scalable web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js).

Collaborate with designers and back-end developers to create seamless user interfaces.

Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs and optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.

Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, adhering to best practices and coding standards.

Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to team knowledge sharing.

Troubleshoot and debug issues, continuously improving the front-end codebase.

Requirements:


Proven experience as a Front End Developer, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work.

Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.

Experience with RESTful APIs and modern front-end build pipelines and tools.

Strong understanding of web performance optimization and cross-browser compatibility.

Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git).

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a remote team environment.

Preferred Qualifications:


Experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux).

Knowledge of front-end testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Jest, Cypress).

Understanding of UX principles and best practices.

Familiarity with Agile methodologies and sprint-based development.

description:
Type: B2B shopping site

Timeline: 4 -6 Weeks with milestones.

Budget: $5500 for experienced developer.

Platform: React JS.

3rd party Integrations:  Stripe Payment, Quickbooks, Finale, Routific, Pipedrive.

Key Features: Set different pricing for each customer, Login to see pricing, Bundle recommendations near add to cart button, Quick order option, limited staff access, staff order on behalf of customer.

___

Here are Looms you can watch to see the way we want to build the site

https://www.loom.com/share/84344adbaf4f49acad21cc496b0122f8?sid=c220995b-69dc-4e7e-8dff-b0eaeef2b778

https://www.loom.com/share/abbfd7d3575245cea5a80ae5c050828f?sid=5236aa48-eebc-445b-a250-e8a713e04e5b

https://www.loom.com/share/2e4903e4e43d459b901a90451060240e?sid=1b2b70cc-a4c2-4d0e-a024-29fc20fc529f

https://www.loom.com/share/bed9aeef9bc14c7090c4870a4d952861?sid=fca138b1-a2ce-4761-b488-6d41c525aa39

https://www.loom.com/share/ab7c407727bc4299a4c8e04c8703ec1f?sid=cd78a660-15f5-4027-9d93-e7209fb64406

Website Access Before Login:

1. Limited catalog visible to visitors; additional products and prices require login.

Website Access After Login:

2. Customer-specific pricing set by Admin.

3. Signup process:

    a. Customer creates an account with name, address, phone number, and email.

    b. System sends automated email confirming application submission.

    c. New account screening: Additional details collected by the secretary and entered into the backend to create customer "profile".

    d. Account approval/rejection by management, with assignment of price markup tier.

    e. Customer receives approval email with temporary login password.

Use Wireframe pro or similar to mockup the site

https://wireframepro.mockflow.com/view/MioK7INbJqb#/page/50c027f6d1af4b239a14e3d981561b12/mode/comment

WEBSITE FEATURES

- ⁠*Search and Browse Page:*

1. Dynamic Filtering Bar with Icon of filter Attributes

   1.1 Provide users with the ability to filter by specific attributes on select pages. Do this by showing an Icon or image indicating the attribute

   1.2 Ability for Admin to easily change Filtering Bar filter attributes

2. Smart Search Engine

   2.1 Provide accurate search results even with customer misspellings

3. Flag Display Badges

   3.1 Set flags to display badges in search results (e.g., best seller, website choice)

- *Item Detail Page:*

4. Bundled Recommendations

   4.1 Display recommended bundles under add to cart button

   4.2 "add all to cart" button near these bundles

   4.3 Ability to create bundle recommendations

5. Favorites List Feature

   5.1 Allow users to create a favorites list for easy access and easy ordering. Also give Employees ability to create this list for customers

- *Checkout & Cart:*

6. Quick Order Feature

   6.1 Enable users to input short descriptions and quantities for quick ordering

7. Cart Functionality

   7.1 Open cart on the right-hand side

   7.2 Easily adjust cart item quantity with +/- signs

- *Order Page:*

8. Subscription Option (Automatic Reorder)

   8.1 Allow users to subscribe to products with status bar indicating if Minimum order amount has been met

   8.2 Admin control for managing subscription orders based on quantity availability

   8.3 Email customers close to ship date if order quantity is below minimum. Recommend relevant items based on customer profile

9. "Can't Find Something?" Feature

   9.1 Enable users to describe desired items for fulfillment at checkout

10. On previous orders page show Add All to Cart Option

- *Admin & Employee Backend:*

11. Customer Profile (admin)

    11.1 Set price tiers and subcategories for personalized pricing and recommended bundles

    11.2 Customer profiles influence pricing tiers and recommended products

    11.3 In profile collect details about the delivery location requirements and display those requirements on order/pick list

12. Manual Order

    12.1 Ability for Employees to enter orders add items to shopping cart on behalf of registered customers

    12.2 Create Employee user accounts for adding these items without giving employees price visibility

- *Additional Functionality:*

13. Chat Function

    13.1 Integrate with a low-cost chat provider that will Display customer order details for current and past orders on mobile devices for Employees to chat and provide customer service

- *Performance:*

14. Fast Page Load Speed

14.1 Consumer Behavior tracking and cookies

14.2 dont reload page when changing item variations

14.3 SSL

description:
Shopify Print on Demand Store Set Up, Product Design and Upload



I am looking for a Virtual Assistant who has experience with setting up Shopify stores and adding new products using Print on Demand.


We want to create a website similar to www.maga.com copying the designs but with some small changes to avoid copyright disputes.


Your role will be to set up and design the entire Shopify website, and to upload and prepare products to launch on the website. You should have experience with setting up Shopify stores and be familiar with Print on Demand suppliers such as Printful, Printify, Gooten and/or others.


You should be able to work with a print designer to produce designs similar to those seen on www.maga.com. You should provide them a list of designs to product and should use a checklist to track progress for design production and product upload.

description:
Client Feedback


  1. Overall, the new designs are much closer to what we want, thank you for your work. Just some feedback on colours - the colours are a bit too saturated and bright and maybe we don't need so many colours either. Here are 2 illustrations for your reference - option 1, option 2
  2. What we like about these - pastel colours in option 1, limited color palette in option 2.
  3. It would be great if you could take a look and implement something like this. What would also be nice is to have the background be a bit more neutral so the visuals and text can pop.
  4. Limiting the colours in the design will also help the buttons (get started) in the accent colours be highlighted more
  5. The headline text can be white I think, unless we're doing a white/black background. Colour on colour is making the design look busy
  6. Lastly, please make sure all vectors are the same style, all three graphics right now do not look like they're the same design style looking at the lines/shadows etc.


A few other things I was hoping you could help with -

  1. Could we get access to the raw figma file you're working on, once we start with the rest of the designs so we can plan next steps based on your progress
  2. Based on today's feedback, would you be able to share a timeline for the rest of the screens?

We are seeking a talented and experienced Web Developer to join our team on a freelance basis. The ideal candidate will have expert skills in Liquid, JavaScript, and CSS and be able to work on small tasks that come in every couple of days. This is a remote, hourly-based contract position. We are looking for someone who is reliable, self-motivated, and able to work independently.

description:
About Us:

We are a dynamic company working on innovative projects and are currently seeking experienced full stack developers / dev teams for a variety of projects and ongoing support. Our immediate need is an expedited project as detailed below:


Project Overview:

This initial project involves building a user portal/site with the following base features:


User Accounts:

Sign in, account email confirmation, and reset password links.


Credit System:

Users purchase credit packs via Stripe.

Credits are used for processing on the site with an auto re-purchase credit option.


API HTTP Endpoint Generation:

Users can generate their own vanity URL endpoints based on input data.

Store the generic JSON for an external HTTP POST request.

Allow users to test generation and see results live in their account.

Each successful POST request deducts credits based on the FX used.

New endpoints can be created, and existing ones deleted.

All endpoints should be secure with a custom user account password that will be used for external authentication (different from login password).


Endpoint Processing:

The site or app will act as a middleman, synchronously sending requests, waiting for responses/images, and returning the response/image.

Scalable solution to handle increasing traffic demands for endpoint processing (potentially thousands per minute in future, but much fewer at start).


Image Storage and Delivery:

Currently using GCP for image storage/delivery.


Visual Reference:

For a detailed visual of the project, please message us and we'll send the visual mockups of the site screens.


What We Are Looking For:

Proven experience in full stack development.

Expertise with user authentication, payment integration, API development, and cloud services such as GCP, AWS, DigitalOcean, Heroku.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively.

A long-term partner/team to support ongoing projects and future development.

App development experience a plus (React Native, Flutter, Swift, etc).

US-Based hours preferable or extended international hours overlapping with 9-11AM MST, or 3-6PM MST (additional hours may be necessary for emergency outages).




Please include the following questions when submitting your proposal to be considered:


Provide examples of similar projects you have completed? Include links or descriptions.

What would be your recommended tech stack for this build based on what you read above?

Proposal for Developing a Marketplace (Website and Mobile App)
1. Project Overview
The objective is to develop a robust marketplace platform comprising a website and a mobile application. The platform will facilitate seamless interactions between buyers and sellers, ensuring a secure, scalable, and sustainable solution using the latest technologies.
2. Project Phases
Requirement Gathering and Analysis
Conduct stakeholder meetings to gather requirements.
Define user roles and functionalities (admin, seller, buyer).
Document technical and non-technical specifications.
Design
UI/UX Design: Develop wireframes and prototypes for user-friendly interfaces.
Architecture Design: Create a scalable architecture that supports microservices.
Development
Backend Development: Implement RESTful APIs using Node.js/Express or Python/Django.
Frontend Development: Build responsive web interfaces using React.js or Vue.js.
Mobile App Development: Develop native apps using Swift for iOS and Kotlin for Android, or use a cross-platform framework like Flutter or React Native.
Database: Use a scalable database solution like PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
Security Implementation
Authentication & Authorization: Implement OAuth 2.0, JWT for secure authentication.
Data Encryption: Ensure data encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest (AES).
Secure Payment Gateway Integration: Integrate secure payment gateways like Stripe or PayPal.
Regular Security Audits: Conduct regular security audits and vulnerability assessments.
Sustainability
Scalable Infrastructure: Deploy on cloud services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud to ensure scalability.
Energy-Efficient Coding Practices: Adopt best coding practices to optimize performance and reduce energy consumption.
Sustainable Business Model: Ensure the platform supports sustainable business practices (e.g., promoting eco-friendly products).
Testing
Unit Testing: Ensure each component functions as expected.
Integration Testing: Test the interaction between different components.
User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Validate the solution with end-users.
Performance Testing: Ensure the platform handles high traffic efficiently.
Deployment
Set up continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
Deploy the solution on a cloud environment.
Ensure zero-downtime deployment strategies.
Maintenance (One Year)
Monitoring: Use tools like New Relic or CloudWatch for continuous monitoring.
Regular Updates: Implement regular updates for security patches and new features.
Customer Support: Provide ongoing technical support and customer service.
Feedback Loop: Collect user feedback for continuous improvement.
Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation for all aspects of the system.
3. Technology Stack
Frontend: React.js/Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3
Backend: Node.js/Express or Python/Django
Mobile App: Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android) or Flutter/React Native
Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB
Cloud Services: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud
Security: OAuth 2.0, JWT, TLS, AES
Payment Integration: Stripe, PayPal
Monitoring: New Relic, CloudWatch

# Job Description:We are a new wine business eager to bring the finest wines to customers through online and e-commerce platforms. We are seeking a knowledgeable and experienced E-commerce and Online Store Setup Specialist to help us launch our online presence.#### Responsibilities:- Develop and implement a comprehensive e-commerce strategy for our wine business.- Set up and configure our online store, ensuring it is user-friendly, visually appealing, and optimized for sales.- Integrate secure payment gateways, shipping options, and inventory management systems.- Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements related to online wine sales.- Collaborate with our team to create and upload product listings with detailed descriptions, images, and pricing.- Implement SEO best practices to increase online visibility and drive organic traffic to the site.- Provide training and support on website management and maintenance.#### Qualifications:- Proven experience in setting up and managing e-commerce websites, preferably in the beverage or wine industry.- Strong knowledge of e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, WooCommerce, or Magento.- Familiarity with web design, SEO, and digital marketing principles.- Excellent project management and organizational skills.- Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with our team.- Passion for wine and an understanding of the wine market is a plus.Join us in making our wine business a success by creating a seamless and engaging online shopping experience for our customers. If you have the expertise and enthusiasm to help us set up our e-commerce and online store, we would love to hear from you!

We are developing a comprehensive real estate application focused on the Dubai market. This app will cater to both investors and agents, providing a wide range of features and information to facilitate informed decision-making and efficient transactions.
Key Features:
Property Listings: Extensive database of properties, including off-plan and completed projects.
ROI, rental Yeild  and CA Calculations: Tools to calculate Return on Investment (ROI) and Capital Appreciation (CA) for properties.
Video Section: A dedicated section where we will upload videos covering certain topics:
Weekly News & Updates: Regular updates on the real estate market, including blogs and tweets.
Exclusive Networking Events: Information on exclusive events for networking. Networking adverts
Global Comparisons: Comparisons of Dubai’s real estate market with other countries and economies.
Contact now: consultcy tabs with a bit of info about All consults,
support tab: customer service
AI Assistance: AI-based support to answer questions related to off-plan property ROI, CA, and DLD processes.

Back-End Development: Expertise in Node.js/Express.js, Python/Django, or similar frameworks.
Database Management: Knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
API Integration: Experience with RESTful APIs and third-party services integration.
Artificial Intelligence: Experience with AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch.
Data Analytics: Ability to implement data analysis and visualization tools.

Security: Ensuring data protection and secure transactions.

Video Management: Capability to upload, manage, and stream videos within the app.
General Requirements:
User Authentication: Secure login and user management system.
Responsive Design: Optimized for both iOS and Android devices.

Performance Optimization: Ensuring fast loading times and smooth user experience.
Testing: Thorough testing for functionality, usability, and security.

data.text: Company Overview:

We are a performance marketing agency that unites brand storytelling with a strong digital foundation to create a message that truly inspires. Our mission is to deliver exceptional digital experiences that drive business growth for our clients.
Position Overview:

We are seeking a skilled Website Developer with expertise in WordPress, Shopify, and other popular web development platforms. As a website developer, you will be responsible for coordinating with our marketing team and web designers to ensure the successful delivery of the project. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in creating and maintaining high-quality websites that are both visually appealing and functionally robust.
Responsibilities:
1) Develop, and maintain websites using WordPress, Shopify, and other platforms.
2) Collaborate with designers and content creators to ensure the website aligns with brand guidelines and project goals.
3) Customize themes and templates to meet the specific needs of each project.
4) Ensure websites are optimized for speed, performance, and SEO.
5) Implement responsive design to ensure websites are mobile-friendly.
6) Troubleshoot and resolve website issues promptly.
7) Stay up-to-date with the latest web development trends and best practices.
Requirements:
1) Proven experience as a Website Developer, with a strong portfolio of previous work.
2) Proficiency in WordPress, Shopify, and other web development platforms.
3) Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.
4) Experience with responsive design and mobile-first development.
5) Familiarity with SEO best practices and website optimization techniques.
6) What is your favorite animal?
6) Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
7) Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
8) Strong communication and collaboration skills.
9) Familiarity with React and Angular.
What to Expect:
Initial Trial - We’ll start with a trial phase. Once you prove your capabilities, we’ll gradually increase the volume of work.
Please apply with:
- A brief cover letter detailing your experience with website development.
- Examples or portfolio pieces showcasing your past work related to this role.
We’ll review your application and get back to you soon. Thanks for considering joining our team!

data.text: Seeking Talented UI/UX Developer

We are looking for a skilled UI/UX Developer to enhance and optimize our website, which is built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery. We aim to improve the overall user experience, streamline navigation, and ensure a responsive design across all devices. Additionally, we are interested in tracking user behavior to gain insights into how visitors interact with our site.Responsibilities:1. Conduct a thorough analysis of our current website to identify areas for improvement in user experience and design.2. Create intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces that align with our brand and business goals.3. Develop responsive web designs that work seamlessly across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.4. Implement interactive elements using JavaScript and jQuery to enhance user engagement.5. Integrate cookies and tracking mechanisms to gather insights into user behavior and interactions on the website.6. Collaborate with our team to ensure alignment with project goals and deliverables.7. Test and debug across multiple browsers and devices to ensure consistency and performance.8. Provide recommendations for continuous improvements and best practices in UI/UX design.Requirements:1. Proven experience as a UI/UX Developer with a strong portfolio showcasing previous work.2. Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery.3. Experience with responsive design and mobile-first development.4. Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and best practices.5. Ability to translate user needs into functional and visually appealing designs.6. Experience in implementing cookies and tracking user interactions to analyze website usage.7. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.8. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.Preferred Qualifications:1. Experience with graphic design tools such as Adobe XD, Figma, or Sketch.2. Knowledge of web accessibility standards and best practices.3. Understanding of SEO principles as they relate to web design.4. Familiarity with version control systems like Git.5. Experience with analytics tools such as Google Analytics or similar for user behavior analysis.Please submit your proposal, including your resume, portfolio, and a brief description of your approach to enhancing user experience on our website. Highlight your experience with tracking user behavior and how you have used these insights to improve UX in previous projects.Additionally, please provide examples of websites you have created before. We look forward to seeing your creative solutions and innovative designs!

data.text: Read Before Applying
If you agency lacks experience in last-mile logistics driver tracking or cannot meet our budget requirements, please do not apply.
We are seeking an experienced development team that can support live products and provide referrals from existing clients. Our current tech stack includes PHP, Laravel, React, and NodeJs.
What We Need:
* Expertise: Proficiency in logistics development, route optimization, and live driver tracking using Google Maps and Routes API.
* Team: We're looking for two full-time full-stack developers to take over our SaaS product, which is currently in beta.
* Budget: Our budget is $5,000 for the full-time engagement of two developers with a PM long term.
About Our Product:

Our SaaS product is a delivery management software that optimizes last-mile delivery operations. For dispatchers, it offers a real-time dashboard to track deliveries, live tracking of drivers, optimize routes, and assign tasks. The software integrates with existing systems and provides analytics for performance monitoring. Drivers use our SaaS product's mobile app for navigation, task updates, and collecting proof of delivery via photos, signatures, and barcodes, while staying in communication with dispatchers. Recipients receive delivery notifications and can track their orders on a live map. Our SaaS product enhances efficiency, reduces costs, and improves customer satisfaction for businesses of all sizes.

Proven experience as a React Native or Flutter Developer.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript (for React Native) or Dart (for Flutter).
Prior experience in creating apps for recruiting agencies.

Project: Dynamic, Conversion-Oriented Shopify Store for Women’s Clothing Boutique

Overview: We are seeking an experienced and creative full stack web developer to design and develop a dynamic SEO friendly Shopify store for a women’s clothing boutique. The goal is to create an eye-catching, high-conversion site that is easy to manage independently in the future.

Deliverables:

o Design custom Shopify themes, sections, and templates.
o Style collection and product pages.
o Develop branding and visual design for all pages.

o Select graphics, colors, visual weight, typefaces, and images according to the brand aesthetics.

o Set up and style the navigation menu, categories, and subcategories.
o Create banner image slideshows.
o Implement image overlays and hover effects for product listing pages.

o Upsell and cross-sell products with product recommendations.
o Utilize exclusivity and urgency tactics subtly to improve conversions.
o Optimize Thank You and Order Confirmation pages.
o Implement special promotional offers for email VIP signups.
• Technical Integration and Optimization:
o Ensure mobile responsiveness.
o Integrate payment systems.
o Integrate Instagram and Facebook feeds into the Shopify landing page.

• Project Management and Support:
o Upload collections and products.
o Allow for reasonable revisions.
o Handle site migration once the site is ready.
o Provide a video tutorial for site updates.
o Offer post-project support if needed.

If you are a talented web developer with a passion for creating engaging, conversion-oriented Shopify stores, we’d love to connect with you. Please provide your portfolio and relevant experience when applying. Thank you!

data.text: Project Overview:

Objective: Develop an app and website from scratch for a shipping company to buy cars from Copart and IAAI auctions, calculate shipping costs, access Carfax reports, and manage accounts. The project will be delivered professionally.
Stakeholders: Management, end-users, admin users.
Deliverables: Web and mobile apps (iOS, Android), admin dashboard, backend system.
Functional Requirements:
User Registration: Sign up, login, password reset.
Car Listings: Integrate Copart and IAAI car listings.
Shipping Cost: Calculate to Aqaba, Jordan; Jebel Ali, UAE; Um Qasr, Iraq.
Carfax Reports: Access reports via icon and search by VIN.
Financial Management: Dashboard for transactions and balances.
Admin Features:
Dashboard: Manage users, cars, transactions, shipping info.
User Management: Add/edit/remove users, assign admins.
Car Management: Add/remove cars in the accounting system.
Reports: Generate user activity and transaction reports.
WhatsApp Integration:
Scan and Send: Scan WhatsApp QR code to connect, then send all car details and images with one click.
Send Watchlist: Select all cars from the watchlist and send details to any contacts or groups on WhatsApp with one click.
Non-Functional Requirements:
Performance: Load listings in 3 seconds, calculate shipping in 2 seconds.
Security: Secure authentication, encrypt data.
Scalability: Support 10,000 users.
Usability: User-friendly, WCAG 2.1 compliant.
Technical Requirements:
To Be Determined: The development team will select the best technologies and platforms.
Constraints:
Budget: Defined after cost analysis.
Timeline: 1-2 months.
Resources: Project manager, developers, QA testers, UI/UX designer.
Assumptions and Dependencies:
Assumptions: Access to APIs, users understand basic app usage.
Dependencies: Successful API integration, cloud hosting.
Acceptance Criteria:
Functionality: All features work, accurate shipping costs, Carfax reports, and WhatsApp integration.
Performance: Meets requirements, positive feedback.
Usability: Intuitive, high user satisfaction.

I'm looking for a talented Shopify developer to bring Oath Clothing's online presence to life. This project involves building a complete Shopify store from scratch. We have an existing site that we need to convert this Woocommerce / Wordpress site to shopify.The main reasons for switching to Shopify are as follows:1) Better customer experience2) Better integration options3) I'm so tired of plugins breaking, vulnerabilities, and conflicts on wordpressWe do NOT need to bring over any database from the current site, just match the main products (about 30 SKUs).We plan to launch as a Shopify Advanced userWhat we need done on shopify:1) Setup the account / taxes / selection of a premium theme / everything2) Migrate over and improve the listings of the 30 agreed upon SKUs3) Help us with critical integrations (3PL, meta ads, one click upsells, etc.)4) Improve overall design - not to be pretty, but with a focus on on customer exp and conversions5) Improve SEO and protect it during the transition6) Setup a subdomain for our existing site to stay as is for our older products7) Test / launch8) ongoing tech support and future improvements at a later dateWe plan to launch as a Shopify Advanced user, with the hopes of switching to "Plus" next year and doing more upgrades then.Please share examples of similar work, especially if you've done any work for ecommerce physical products that do between $500k - $5M in revenue  annually.

data.text: Looking for a team who can take care of the web calculator of a greentech solution and bringing android and ios app for saving consumptions watts, money.
People can input their appliances and can see energy consumption and benefits of switching to green solar systems.
1- Your Website's web calculator with great colors and more creative fields, banner on the section where people can easily calculate their daily consumptions and can they can save lot of money/Watts.
2- Android /iOS apps where people will download apps from your website and they will have lot of energy savings, watts savings and they can give 5 star ratings to your business.

We will do some of the graphical changes on the website on calculator page which is required much to be changed. We will put some great colors, fonts and icons so that page will look attractive and very eye catching for people.
The features of apps will be like-
1. Dashboard / Home Screen:
Purpose: Provide users with a real-time display of energy consumption and tools to manage energy usage efficiently.
Functional Requirements:
Display real-time energy consumption in watts (W) or kilowatts (kW).
Allow users to input and adjust:
Appliance usage hours per day/week/month.
Energy tariffs (cost per unit of energy consumed).
Efficiency ratings for appliances (optional).
Calculate and display total energy consumption based on inputs.
Update energy usage display dynamically as inputs change.
Provide visual feedback on current usage compared to previous periods.
Non-functional Requirements:
Ensure real-time updates with minimal latency.
Responsive design for optimal viewing on desktop and mobile devices.
Secure user authentication and session management.
2. Device Identification and Tracking:
Purpose: Enable users to track and manage energy usage by identifying and categorizing specific appliances.
Functional Requirements:
Allow users to manually input details for specific appliances/devices:
Name of appliance/device.
Power rating (in watts or kW).
Estimate energy consumption for each appliance/device based on:
Usage hours input by the user.
Efficiency ratings (if available).
Provide a breakdown of total energy consumption by appliance/device.
Non-functional Requirements:
Ensure ease of use in adding, editing, and removing appliances/devices.
Support for a comprehensive list of common appliances and custom entries.
3. Energy Cost Estimation:
Purpose: Help users understand and manage their energy costs based on usage and tariffs.
Functional Requirements:
Calculate energy costs based on user-inputted:
Energy tariffs (per kWh).
Regional tariffs (if applicable).
Provide a detailed cost breakdown per:
Appliance/usage scenario.
Time period (daily, weekly, monthly).
Display cost estimates alongside energy consumption data.
Non-functional Requirements:
Accuracy in cost calculations based on tariff rates.
Support for multiple tariff structures and regional variations.
4. Historical Data and Trends:
Purpose: Enable users to visualize and analyze historical energy usage patterns.
Functional Requirements:
Display graphical representations (graphs/charts) of:
Historical energy usage trends over specified periods (day, week, month, year).
Changes in energy costs over time.
Allow users to view and compare multiple historical data sets.
Non-functional Requirements:
Performance optimization for loading and displaying large datasets.
Interactive charts with zoom and pan functionalities for detailed analysis.

data.text: To practice SQL effectively, start with mastering fundamental commands like SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE for data manipulation. Progress to advanced functionalities such as JOIN operations and WHERE clauses for filtering, and use aggregate functions like COUNT and AVG for data summarization. Learn efficient data organization through indexes, constraints, and normalization, and practice creating and modifying database schemas. Focus on writing optimized queries and understanding execution plans, and incorporate version control for maintaining SQL scripts. Apply your skills to real-world scenarios with mock datasets and use online resources for additional learning. Consistent practice will sharpen your technical aptitude and problem-solving skills, preparing you for careers in database administration, data analysis, and software development. This structured approach will help you transform raw data into meaningful insights, emphasizing the importance of SQL in data management and analysis.

data.text: Job Description:

We are seeking a skilled mobile app developer to create an innovative calorie-counting app for both iOS and Android platforms. The app will utilize advanced techniques such as food segmentation, classification, and depth estimation to accurately calculate the calories in food.
Key Features:
Food Segmentation: The app should be able to segment food items in an image effectively.
Food Classification: Each segmented food item should be classified accurately to identify the type of food.
Calorie Calculation: Using depth estimation, the app should determine the size and volume of the food to calculate the calories without requiring manual mapping of coordinates.
Reference:
For a similar project, please refer to CalorieCamV2 on GitHub
https://github.com/negi111111/CalorieCamV2
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fPdq_9fAYw
. However, we are looking for a more advanced solution where mapping the coordinates manually is not required, offering a smoother and more automated user experience.
Requirements:
Experience with iOS and Android development.
Proficiency in machine learning, particularly in image segmentation and classification.
Experience with depth estimation models for mobile applications.
Ability to implement a user-friendly interface that integrates seamlessly with the app’s backend.
Familiarity with relevant libraries and tools for food segmentation and calorie estimation.
Deliverables:
A fully functional app for both iOS and Android platforms.

data.text: We are seeking an experienced React Native developer to build a dynamic live events app, "EventConnect," designed to allow users to participate in real-time events via their mobile devices. The app will serve a wide range of events, including concerts, workshops, real estate showings, and more, providing an engaging and interactive platform.
Project Objectives:
Develop a Cross-Platform App: Use React Native to ensure a seamless experience on both iOS and Android platforms.
Real-Time User Interaction: Enable users to join events, engage through live chats, polls, and potentially video streaming.
Event Management Tools: Provide organizers with the ability to create and manage events, communicate with attendees, and gather feedback.
Scalable Solution: Build an architecture capable of handling a large number of concurrent users without performance issues.
Key Features:
User Authentication:
Secure registration and login using email and social media platforms (e.g., Facebook, Google).
User profile management.
Event Creation and Management:
Dashboard for organizers to create, edit, and manage events.
Calendar integration for scheduling events.
Live Interaction Features:
Real-time chat for event attendees.
Polls and surveys to engage participants.
Notifications and reminders for upcoming events.
Location Services:
Integration with maps for location-based events.
Directions and navigation features for attendees.
Payment Integration:
Set up a secure payment gateway (e.g., Stripe) for ticket purchases and event fees.
Analytics and Reporting:
Provide insights into user engagement, attendance, and feedback.
Generate reports for event organizers to improve future events.
Admin Dashboard:
Tools for moderators to oversee events, manage content, and ensure smooth operations.
Responsibilities:
UI/UX Design: Design an intuitive and engaging interface for both users and organizers.
App Development: Build the app using React Native, ensuring performance and reliability across platforms.
API Integration: Work with third-party APIs for payment processing, social media, and analytics.
Testing and QA: Perform thorough testing to ensure the app is free of bugs and provides a great user experience.
Deployment and Maintenance: Handle app deployment to app stores and provide ongoing maintenance and updates.
Requirements:
Experience: Proven experience in mobile app development using React Native, with a portfolio of released apps.
Skills: Proficiency in JavaScript and experience with TypeScript is a plus.
Tools: Familiarity with Redux, Firebase, and RESTful APIs.
Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and the ability to work in a collaborative environment.

data.text: Job Opportunity: Website Designer & Developer (WordPress Expertise)
About the Role:

As our Website Designer & Developer, you will play a critical role in designing and developing visually appealing and highly functional websites for a variety of clients. Your primary focus will be on creating stunning WordPress sites, including those with e-commerce capabilities. In addition to WordPress, you will also work on developing apps and enhancing the digital presence of our clients through innovative web solutions.
Responsibilities:
Design and develop responsive, user-friendly websites using WordPress.
Create and customise WordPress themes and plugins to meet client needs.
Develop and implement e-commerce functionalities, ensuring seamless user experiences for online shopping.
Collaborate with our design and marketing teams to translate creative concepts into functional websites.
Optimize websites for performance, speed, and SEO.
Ensure cross-platform and cross-browser compatibility for all web projects.
Provide technical support and troubleshooting as needed.
Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in web development and digital marketing.
Qualifications:
Proven experience in website design and development, with a strong portfolio showcasing WordPress projects.
Proficiency in WordPress, including theme and plugin development and customisation.
Experience with e-commerce platforms and integrating e-commerce functionalities into websites (e.g., WooCommerce).
Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.
Experience with responsive design and mobile-first development.
Familiarity with web performance optimisation and SEO best practices.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Why Join Us?
Be part of a creative and innovative team that values your ideas and expertise.
Work on exciting and diverse projects for a variety of clients.
How to Apply:
If you are a talented Website Designer & Developer with a passion for creating beautiful, functional websites, we want to hear from you! PLEASE NO TIME WASTERS!!
Start Date: ASAP
Join us in crafting exceptional digital experiences for our clients and take your career to the next level!

data.text: Project Overview:

We are developing a mobile app aimed at incentivizing parents to engage in activities with their children. The app will provide analytics on their progress, offer rewards for documented activities, and feature a statewide leaderboard. Our target audience includes new parents and busy parents who need support and reminders to connect with their children. Key features include daily and weekly quests, a notification system for the other parent, and a leaderboard.
Deliverables:
Design and development of the app for both iOS and Android platforms.
Creation of design mockups and wireframes with input from us.
Implementation of features such as photo documentation, notification system, and leaderboards.
Documentation for the code and user manuals.
Conduct functional and user acceptance testing.
Project completion timeline: 3 to 6 months.
Skills Required:
Proficiency in cross-platform development tools (e.g., React Native, Flutter) to ensure scalability and future expansion.
Experience with Firebase or similar backend services.
Strong UI/UX design skills.
Knowledge of integrating notification systems and leaderboards.
Budget:
$1,000 for the initial development phase.
Potential for profit-sharing with the developer for a certain period.
Communication:
Preferred channels: Slack for daily communication, Zoom for weekly check-ins.
Regular updates on progress, with a response time expectation of within 24 hours for emails.
Working Style:
Remote work environment.
Open to any project management tools the developer prefers.
Open to suggestions on development methodology, with an interest in Agile practices.
Flexible working hours.
Additional Information:
We are looking for a developer who can take initiative and provide creative input, especially in the design phase.
Please include examples of previous work, particularly any apps related to parenting or gamification.

TaskName: Eboost - checkout page discount code issue

data.text: Hey Komal thank you for this inquiry.
So to summarize,

What is happening is that based off of the cart we built customers get a free gift when they add enough items [based on price] to their cart. Once the cart hits their threshold [$100] they get the free gift. HOWEVER, once this threshold is hit [$100] customers can still use discount codes AND receive this free gift.
So we need to make it so that cart only gives out the free gift IF the total, even after discounts and codes is over $100

data.text: Shopify Developer required for long term work

Hi there,Our Web Development and Digital Marketing company is looking for an experienced Shopify developer, proficient with building and modifying themes, modifying page layouts, and recommending and configuring integrations to achieve results such as integrating email automation platforms, up-sell and cross-sell options, and popups. data.text: We are developing a Web3 e-commerce service using the following frontend technology stack:
- TypeScript
- Next.js
- Chakra UI (we are open to using other UI component libraries)

Currently, we have completed 70% of the service using Next.js and Chakra UI. 2. Commitment to staying updated and working with the latest tech stack.

2. Confirmation that you have read and agree to the job requirements. Please do not apply if you cannot meet these requirements.
3. Your GitHub profile URL.
We look forward to reviewing your application.
Thank you.

data.text: We're a staffing company seeking a skilled WordPress expert to help maintain and enhance our website. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of WordPress, Elementor, and troubleshooting website issues.
**Key Responsibilities:**
* **Elementor Expertise:**  Work within Elementor to update and create new website pages, ensuring a visually appealing and user-friendly experience.
* **Troubleshooting:**  Diagnose and resolve any existing website issues, ensuring optimal performance and functionality.
* **Content Management:**  Upload and format blog posts, ensuring proper SEO optimization and a consistent brand voice.
* **Landing Page Creation:**  Design and implement effective landing pages for specific marketing campaigns, using Elementor to create engaging layouts.
**Requirements:**
* **Proven WordPress Experience:**  Demonstrated expertise in WordPress website management and development.
* **Elementor Proficiency:**  Strong skills in using Elementor for page building and design.
* **Troubleshooting Skills:** Ability to identify and resolve website errors and performance issues.
* **Content Management Experience:**  Experience in uploading and formatting blog posts and other website content.

data.text: We are seeking a talented and motivated Mobile App Developer to create a fully functional and user-friendly mobile application for our Shopify-based online store. data.text: We are looking for a skilled and experienced development team to build a sophisticated data marketplace platform. This platform will enable users to monetize their data by auctioning it to advertisers in real time. The platform should feature real-time bidding, data categorization, AI chatbot integration, and a user-friendly interface.
**Team Requirements**:
- **Backend Developers**: Expertise in building scalable server-side logic and APIs.
- **Frontend Developers**: Ability to create responsive and intuitive user interfaces.
- **AI/ML Engineers**: Experience in AI chatbot development and machine learning for data categorization.
- **Data Engineers**: Skilled in managing big data technologies and data pipelines.
- **Security Experts**: Knowledge of data privacy laws and cybersecurity best practices.
- **DevOps Engineers**: Experience in managing cloud infrastructure and CI/CD processes.
- **UX/UI Designers**: Proficiency in creating user-friendly and visually appealing designs.
- **QA/Test Engineers**: Competence in automated and manual testing to ensure platform reliability.
**Project Duration**: 3-6 months

We are looking for a committed team capable of delivering a high-quality product within the specified timeline and budget. Please include case studies or previous projects that demonstrate your ability to handle similar challenges.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in web development, with expertise in modern web technologies and a keen eye for detail.Scope:Please provide a fixed fee bid for the following:- Development of 4 domains. 2 on WordPress, 2 on Shopify- Unify all websites look and feel utilizing 10 templates from our creative team- 50 total pages to developed across all domainsResponsibilities:- Develop and maintain a responsive, user-friendly website- Collaborate with our design and content teams to implement UI/UX designs- Optimize website performance and ensure cross-browser compatibility- Troubleshoot and resolve website issues promptly- Integrate third-party tools and APIs as neededRequirements:- Proven experience as a web developer (please provide portfolio)- Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and relevant frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js)- Experience with backend technologies (e.g., Node.js, PHP, Python, or Ruby)- Knowledge of SEO best practices- Ability to meet deadlines and work independentlyPreferred Qualifications:- Experience with e-commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify, WooCommerce)- Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git)- Strong problem-solving skills

data.text: Shopify Plus Expert for Comprehensive Store Development and Maintenance

Gorilla Stationers is inviting proposals from experienced Shopify Plus experts to assist in the setup, development, and ongoing maintenance of our Shopify Plus store. We seek a partner with extensive Shopify Plus experience, particularly in managing large-scale product integrations and drop shipping operations.Project Objectives:• Enhance the user experience on our Shopify Plus store.• Streamline product management and ensure the accuracy of a large product catalog.• Reduce refunds due to out-of-stock items by ensuring real-time inventory synchronization.• Target federal and state departments, as well as companies that purchase in bulk.Scope of Work:1. Development Environment:o Set up a development account within Shopify for store creation and testing.o Manage the transition from the development environment to the live store.2. Product Synchronization and Integration:o Integrate approximately 1 million products from six key vendors.o Manage overlapping products by displaying only the cheapest option.o Synchronize products from four vendors using Inventory Source.o Import data from one vendor via a CSV aggregator, handling the monthly update of over 300,000 products.o Integrate products from another vendor using HTML programming according to a specific manual.3. Website Design and User Experience (UX):o Design a user-friendly interface with advanced search filters and personalized recommendations.o Implement a guest checkout option.o Allow customers to contact sales directly via WhatsApp.4. Product Data Management:o Implement regular reviews of product data to ensure accuracy in images, descriptions, sizes, and other details.5. Ongoing Maintenance:o Provide ongoing maintenance, ensuring all store aspects function correctly and reflect the latest vendor updates.Deliverables:• Development environment setup.• Successful integration of over 1 million products.• Fully functional, visually appealing Shopify Plus store with improved UX.• Documented process for ongoing product updates and maintenance.Resources Required:• One Shopify Plus expert with at least three years of experience.• Access to Shopify Plus, Inventory Source, CSV Aggregator, and HTML for manual programming.Proposal Submission: Please submit your proposal, including:• A detailed project plan and timeline.• A breakdown of costs.• Relevant experience and examples of past projects.• References from previous clients.Acceptance Criteria:• The website will be tested by simulating customer experiences to ensure all functionalities are working correctly and the product data is accurate.• Ongoing testing by our Operational Manager will ensure the site meets all quality standards.We look forward to reviewing your proposals and selecting a partner who can help us achieve our project goals.

data.text: I want to create a mobile application that can assist others in their journey of self-development. The aim of this app is to provide a comprehensive and engaging platform that combines the power of technology with the principles of personal development.

To bring this vision to life, I am in need of a skilled specialist who can contribute their expertise on the technical aspects of the project. This individual should possess a deep understanding of software development, user interface design, and the integration of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning.

In addition to the technical expertise, I am also seeking a collaborator who can help me structure the content of the app in a meaningful and impactful way. This includes curating and organizing a diverse range of resources, such as interactive exercises, personalized assessments, inspirational content, and guided tutorials, all aimed at empowering users to unlock their full potential.

The integration of the latest advancements in AI technology is crucial to the success of this endeavor. I envision the app to be equipped with intelligent algorithms and predictive analytics that can adapt to the user's individual needs, providing personalized recommendations, goal-setting support, and real-time feedback to maximize the user's progress and engagement.

By combining the technical expertise, content curation, and the integration of cutting-edge AI capabilities, I believe we can create a transformative self-development app that can positively impact the lives of countless individuals.

data.text: Hello! I’m a solo entrepreneur with a fully designed SaaS platform idea, carefully crafted in Figma. I am currently in the validation stage and looking for an experienced web developer to collaborate on building out this platform in stages. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of an exciting project from the ground up.
What I’m Looking For:
I’m seeking a developer who can:

Guide us through their development process: I’m particularly interested in understanding how you approach building a web app from scratch. What are the key steps you take to ensure the project is a success? How do you break down the work into manageable phases?
Achieve success in web app development: I need someone who can not only build but also advise on best practices. Your expertise will help shape the technical foundation of the app.

Stand out from the crowd: Tell me what sets you apart from other developers. Whether it’s your approach to problem-solving, your unique skill set, or your attention to detail—show me why you’re the right fit for this project.

Focus on coding excellence: I’m looking for someone who is committed to clean, efficient, and maintainable code. How do you ensure the highest quality in your coding techniques? How do you stay up to date with best practices and implement them?
Project Overview:
Stage 1: Collaborate to finalize technical requirements and plan out the development phases.
Stage 2: Begin development, focusing on the core features of the platform.
Stage 3: Testing, iteration, and preparation for launch.
Skills Required:
Strong experience in web app development (please share examples of previous SaaS projects)
Proficiency in modern web technologies (React, Node.js, AWS, etc.)
Familiarity with Figma or ability to translate design files into functional code
Excellent communication and project management skills
Additional Information:
I’m looking for a long-term partnership. If the initial stages go well, there’s potential for ongoing work as we scale the platform.
Please include a brief outline of your development process and how you ensure the success of a project in your proposal.
I’m excited to hear from you and see how we can make this SaaS platform a reality together!

data.text: Dropshipping for Home Decor/Furniture Store Creation and Marketing

We are looking for an experienced professional to create a high-quality dropshipping home decor/furniture store based around our brand which is our home. We have photo and video content which is ready to be used on the website. Our home is inspired by a chateau design through which we have showcased many different events such as car shows, music videos, movies, fashion shows, etc. Our home has been recognized by famous artists, directors and influencers. We hope to use all this as our marketing technique. We are looking for an experienced freelancer who will be responsible for setting up the store, selecting and sourcing products, designing a visually appealing website, optimizing for search engines, and implementing marketing strategies. Excellent communication and project management skills are required to ensure timely delivery and successful execution of the project. We have a brand/identity which represents luxury, class, royalty and so we are looking for products on our website which showcase this. We are looking for high-quality products to drop-ship so the freelancer should be able to have the ability to research and find the best products/suppliers. We would like to create a store with a variety of home decor, from small items (i.e. silverware, plates, wallpapers), to large items (i.e. desks, coffee tables, sofas, etc). We have tons of references such as sample websites, product ideas, potential suppliers, house content, etc. which we can also provide in order to show the direction we want to go in. We are looking to create a high-quality drop-shipping website rather than a basic website which uses generic products/suppliers therefore only freelancers with vast drop-shipping/web development experience will be considered for this project.Relevant skills:- Dropshipping- Web Development- Front-End Development- Quality Inspection- Supplier Search- Product Research- Product Description- E-commerce website (Shopify, WooCommerce, etc)- Product sourcing- Web design- SEO- Social Media Marketing (i.e. Instagram, TikTok, Google)- Content MarketingSize: Medium-LargeDuration: 1 to 3 monthsExpertise: Expert
