Estimated Time (05 hrs)


Every topic in practice is compulsory and create a separate file for every practice


8.1 Date (3hr)

- JavaScript simplifies date and time manipulation through the Date object, a versatile tool for managing temporal information in web applications.


8.1.1 Date Object: (15 min)

- The Date object represents a date and time in JavaScript. You can create a new date object using the new Date() constructor.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date


8.1.2 Get Date Functions: (45 min)

- The Date object has methods to retrieve various aspects of the date and time.

  • getFullYear(): Returns the year.
  • getMonth(): Returns the month (0-11).
  • getDate(): Returns the day of the month.
  • getHours(): Returns the hour.
  • getMinutes(): Returns the minutes.
  • getSeconds(): Returns the seconds.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date


8.1.3 Set Date Function: (45 min)

- The Date object also has methods to set various components of the date and time.

  • setFullYear(year): Sets the year.
  • setMonth(month): Sets the month (0-11).
  • setDate(day): Sets the day of the month.
  • setHours(hours): Sets the hour.
  • setMinutes(minutes): Sets the minutes.
  • setSeconds(seconds): Sets the seconds.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date



8.1.4 Formatting Dates: (45 min)

- Formatting dates in JavaScript often involves constructing a string with the desired format. Libraries like moment.js or the built-in toLocaleString() method can be used for more advanced formatting.


- Example using toLocaleString():- let currentDate = new Date(); let formattedDate = currentDate.toLocaleString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); print the output in console.log(formattedDate ).


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date


8.1.5 Sorting Dates: (30 min)

- To sort an array of dates, you can use the sort() method and provide a custom comparison function.


- Example:- let dateArray = [new Date('2023-01-01'), new Date('2022-12-31'), new Date('2023-02-01')]; dateArray.sort((a, b) => b - a); print the output in console.log(dateArray )


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date



8.2 Debugging (1hr)

- Debugging in JavaScript refers to the process of identifying and fixing errors or bugs in your code. It's an essential skill for developers to ensure their programs run smoothly and produce the expected results. JavaScript provides several tools and techniques for debugging, including:


- Console Logging: Placing console.log() statements at strategic points in your code allows you to print values and messages to the browser console, helping you understand the flow of your program and identify issues.

- Debugger Statement: Placing the debugger; statement in your code will pause execution at that point if the browser's developer tools are open, allowing you to interactively inspect the state of your application.

- Exception Handling: Using try, catch, and throw statements allows you to handle exceptions gracefully and provides an opportunity to log or debug errors without crashing your entire application.

- Linting Tools: Tools like ESLint can help you identify and fix common coding errors and style issues, promoting clean and error-free code.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_debugging.asp
  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/console


8.4 LocalStorage & Session Storage (1hr)

- localStorage: localStorage is a type of web storage that persists even when the browser is closed and reopened. Data stored in localStorage remains available until explicitly cleared by the user or the web application.

- sessionStorage: sessionStorage is similar to localStorage but has a shorter lifespan. Data stored in sessionStorage is accessible only for the duration of the page session. It gets cleared when the page is closed or the browser is restarted.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://javascript.info/localstorage
  • https://www.w3schools.com/jsref/prop_win_localstorage.asp
  • https://www.w3schools.com/jsref/prop_win_sessionstorage.asp

The else statement provides an alternative block of code to execute when the if condition is false. Additionally, else if allows you to check multiple conditions sequentially, executing the corresponding block of code for the first true condition.

- In JavaScript, the switch statement provides a way to execute different code blocks based on the value of an expression. It evaluates the expression against multiple case values and executes the block of code associated with the first matching case. The default case is optional and is executed if none of the cases match. The switch statement offers a more concise and readable alternative to multiple if-else statements when comparing a single value against multiple possibilities.


Follow the below link to learn more

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_switch.asp

- In JavaScript, loops are used to repeatedly execute a block of code. The for loop is a common construct with an initialization statement, a condition for continuation, and an increment/decrement statement. The do-while loop is similar but ensures the block of code is executed at least once, as the condition is checked after the loop body. Estimated Time (05 hrs)


Every topic in practice is compulsory and create a separate file for every practice


8.1 Date (3hr)

- JavaScript simplifies date and time manipulation through the Date object, a versatile tool for managing temporal information in web applications.


8.1.1 Date Object: (15 min)

- The Date object represents a date and time in JavaScript. You can create a new date object using the new Date() constructor.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date


8.1.2 Get Date Functions: (45 min)

- The Date object has methods to retrieve various aspects of the date and time.

  • getFullYear(): Returns the year.
  • getMonth(): Returns the month (0-11).
  • getDate(): Returns the day of the month.
  • getHours(): Returns the hour.
  • getMinutes(): Returns the minutes.
  • getSeconds(): Returns the seconds.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date


8.1.3 Set Date Function: (45 min)

- The Date object also has methods to set various components of the date and time.

  • setFullYear(year): Sets the year.
  • setMonth(month): Sets the month (0-11).
  • setDate(day): Sets the day of the month.
  • setHours(hours): Sets the hour.
  • setMinutes(minutes): Sets the minutes.
  • setSeconds(seconds): Sets the seconds.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date



8.1.4 Formatting Dates: (45 min)

- Formatting dates in JavaScript often involves constructing a string with the desired format. Libraries like moment.js or the built-in toLocaleString() method can be used for more advanced formatting.


- Example using toLocaleString():- let currentDate = new Date(); let formattedDate = currentDate.toLocaleString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); print the output in console.log(formattedDate ).


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date


8.1.5 Sorting Dates: (30 min)

- To sort an array of dates, you can use the sort() method and provide a custom comparison function.


- Example:- let dateArray = [new Date('2023-01-01'), new Date('2022-12-31'), new Date('2023-02-01')]; dateArray.sort((a, b) => b - a); print the output in console.log(dateArray )


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date



8.2 Debugging (1hr)

- Debugging in JavaScript refers to the process of identifying and fixing errors or bugs in your code. It's an essential skill for developers to ensure their programs run smoothly and produce the expected results. JavaScript provides several tools and techniques for debugging, including:


- Console Logging: Placing console.log() statements at strategic points in your code allows you to print values and messages to the browser console, helping you understand the flow of your program and identify issues.

- Debugger Statement: Placing the debugger; statement in your code will pause execution at that point if the browser's developer tools are open, allowing you to interactively inspect the state of your application.

- Exception Handling: Using try, catch, and throw statements allows you to handle exceptions gracefully and provides an opportunity to log or debug errors without crashing your entire application.

- Linting Tools: Tools like ESLint can help you identify and fix common coding errors and style issues, promoting clean and error-free code.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_debugging.asp
  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/console


8.4 LocalStorage & Session Storage (1hr)

- localStorage: localStorage is a type of web storage that persists even when the browser is closed and reopened. Data stored in localStorage remains available until explicitly cleared by the user or the web application.

- sessionStorage: sessionStorage is similar to localStorage but has a shorter lifespan. Data stored in sessionStorage is accessible only for the duration of the page session. It gets cleared when the page is closed or the browser is restarted.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://javascript.info/localstorage
  • https://www.w3schools.com/jsref/prop_win_localstorage.asp
  • https://www.w3schools.com/jsref/prop_win_sessionstorage.asp

Loops provide a powerful mechanism for automating repetitive tasks in JavaScript programs.

description:
Estimated Time (05hr 10 min)


Practice is compulsory for every topic and creates a separate file for each topic


2.1 Style Guide (30min)

- JavaScript style guide promotes consistent and readable code by emphasizing practices such as 2-space indentation, the use of const for variables, camelCase for naming, and the adoption of ES6 features.


Follow the below link to learn more.

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_conventions.asp
  • https://github.com/airbnb/javascript


2.2 Variables (20min)

- In JavaScript, variables are used to store and manipulate data. They are declared using keywords like var, let, or const. var and let allow for variable reassignment, while const declares a variable with a constant value. Proper naming conventions such as camelCase are encouraged for variables, enhancing code readability.


Follow the below link to learn more 

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_variables.asp
  • https://www.javatpoint.com/javascript-variable


2.3 Variables Data Types (01hr 30min)

- JavaScript supports various data types, including primitive types like numbers, strings, booleans, null, and undefined. Properly leveraging these data types enhances the flexibility and efficiency of your JavaScript applications.


Follow the below link to learn more 

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_datatypes.asp
  • https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/javascript-data-types


2.4 Variables Data Type Conversion (01hr)

- JavaScript automatically performs type conversion, allowing values to be transformed between different data types. This process can be implicit, where JavaScript coerces types during operations, or explicit, using functions like Number(), String(), and Boolean().


Follow the below link to learn more 

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_type_conversion.asp
  • https://www.programiz.com/javascript/type-conversion


2.5 JavaScript Operator (01hr 30min)

- JavaScript operators are symbols or keywords that perform operations on operands, such as variables or values. They include arithmetic operators like + and -, comparison operators like === and !==, logical operators such as && and ||, and assignment operators like =.


Follow the below link to learn more

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_operators.asp
  • https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/javascript-operators


2.6 Scope (20min)

- Scope in JavaScript refers to the context in which variables are declared and can be accessed. JavaScript has two main types of scope: global and local. Variables declared outside any function or block have global scope, while those declared within functions or blocks have local scope.


Follow the below link to learn more 

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_scope.asp
  • https://www.programiz.com/javascript/variable-scope

data.text: Job Description:

We are a dynamic company looking for a skilled contractor or agency to partner with us on a variety of ongoing projects. The ideal candidate(s) will have a broad range of expertise, including web development, mobile application development, platform building, AI chatbot integration, and Ecommerce solutions. We are looking for a long-term partnership to support our projects as the need arises.
Responsibilities:
• Design and develop engaging, user-friendly websites with a strong focus on performance, responsiveness, and SEO.
• Build robust and scalable mobile applications across both iOS and Android platforms.
• Develop and maintain complex platforms, ensuring seamless integration of front-end and back-end functionalities.
• Integrate AI chatbots into our systems to enhance user experience and streamline operations.
• Create and manage Ecommerce stores, focusing on smooth functionality, payment integration, and user experience.
• Implement and manage various automations on websites to optimize efficiency and enhance interactivity.
Requirements:
• Extensive experience in web development with a diverse portfolio of completed projects.
• Strong proficiency in mobile application development for both iOS and Android.
• Expertise in building and maintaining platforms that require complex integrations.
• Proven experience in developing and integrating AI chatbots.
• Comprehensive knowledge of Ecommerce platforms and experience in building and scaling online stores.
• Ability to link and automate website processes using tools like Zapier, Integromat, or similar platforms.
• Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
• Flexibility to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Prior experience working with AI technologies and machine learning.
• Proficiency in modern web development frameworks and languages (e.g., React, Angular, Node.js).
• Familiarity with leading Ecommerce platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce, or Magento.
• Experience with cloud-based development and hosting services such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Why Partner with Us:
• Opportunity to work on diverse and challenging projects.
• Potential for a long-term collaboration with consistent project opportunities.
• Flexible working arrangements and competitive compensation.

Application Instructions: Please submit your resume or agency profile along with a portfolio showcasing your work. Include a cover letter outlining your experience with the required skills, your approach to project management, and how you envision supporting our ongoing needs.

data.text: Full Shopify Ecommerce Development for Wellness Brand - Visually Striking and Unique Design

We are partners of the brand "Blessy," a wellness brand in Brazil focused on women aged 18 to 35. Our inspiration for creating Blessy comes from brands like Bloom Nutrition (https://bloomnu.com). Currently, we offer a main product, which is Greens & Superfoods in lemon and mango flavors, and we are planning to expand our line with new flavors and products, including pre-workouts and hormonal balance supplements.What We Need:We are looking for an experienced developer to create a complete ecommerce site on Shopify. We want a site that is not only functional but also visually striking, with a sexy, modern design that truly stands out in the wellness market. This will most likely involve ultra-customization of an existing Shopify theme or even the development of a custom theme to achieve the unique look and feel we desire. The ecommerce site needs to be 100% functional and ready for launch.Project Requirements:Full development of the website on the Shopify platform.Visually striking and sexy design with a unique visual identity.Extensive customization of an existing Shopify theme or development of a custom theme to meet our design needs.Complete integration of ecommerce functionalities, including checkout, payment gateway, and other necessary features for a high-performance ecommerce site.Mobile optimization to ensure a flawless user experience across all devices.Basic SEO setup to ensure the site is ready to be found by search engines.Integration with our social media and marketing platforms.Ease of use for us to add new products, categories, and content in the future.Design References:We are looking for something on the same visual level and impact as the following stores:Lemme Live: https://lemmelive.com/Poppi: https://drinkpoppi.com/Salud: https://tastesalud.com/Bloom Nutrition: https://bloomnu.com/Timeline and Delivery:The timeline for project completion will be agreed upon, but we are looking for a swift development process. Please send examples of previous work that align with the type of design we are seeking and a detailed proposal of what you can offer.We look forward to seeing what you can create for Blessy!

data.text: We are seeking an experienced development team to build out additional features for our existing social app, which allows influencers to share pay-per-view content with their fans. Currently, content is initially blurred, and fans can purchase credits to unblur and view it for a limited time before it is blurred again. To enhance the app’s functionality and user experience, we require several new features to be developed.
Features to be Developed:

1) New Credit Type (Blue Credit): Implement a new credit type that has no monetary value, which will be given to new users upon sign-up and to users in the event of technical discrepancies. These Blue Credits cannot be used for tipping or transfers.
2) Customizable Credit Pricing for Creators: Enable creators to set the amount of credits they want to charge for unlocking their posts.
3) NSFW Label: Add a "Not Safe for Work" (NSFW) label that appears on adult content. Creators will have the ability to toggle a switch on each post to mark it as NSFW.
4) Fan Blocking/Unblocking: Allow creators to block or unblock specific fans from viewing/commenting on their posts or messaging them.
5) App Store Screens Update: Update the app’s screens in the App Store to reflect the latest design and feature changes.
6) Referral System for Creators: Develop a referral system where creators can refer other creators to the platform and earn revenue from their referrals.
Requirements:
- Proficiency in Node.js and Express to handle web admin panel modifications.
- Expertise in React Native for integrating new features into the app’s front-end.
- Knowledge of Typescript for building out the back-end functionality.
- Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and GitHub for file management and version control.
Project Timeline:
This project is expected to be completed within one month.

rawDescription:
We are seeking an experienced development team to build out additional features for our existing social app, which allows influencers to share pay-per-view content with their fans. Currently, content is initially blurred, and fans can purchase credits to unblur and view it for a limited time before it is blurred again. To enhance the app’s functionality and user experience, we require several new features to be developed.
Features to be Developed:
1) New Credit Type (Blue Credit): Implement a new credit type that has no monetary value, which will be given to new users upon sign-up and to users in the event of technical discrepancies. These Blue Credits cannot be used for tipping or transfers.
2) Customizable Credit Pricing for Creators: Enable creators to set the amount of credits they want to charge for unlocking their posts.
3) NSFW Label: Add a "Not Safe for Work" (NSFW) label that appears on adult content. Creators will have the ability to toggle a switch on each post to mark it as NSFW.
4) Fan Blocking/Unblocking: Allow creators to block or unblock specific fans from viewing/commenting on their posts or messaging them.
5) App Store Screens Update: Update the app’s screens in the App Store to reflect the latest design and feature changes.
6) Referral System for Creators: Develop a referral system where creators can refer other creators to the platform and earn revenue from their referrals.
Requirements:
- Proficiency in Node.js and Express to handle web admin panel modifications.
- Expertise in React Native for integrating new features into the app’s front-end.
- Knowledge of Typescript for building out the back-end functionality.
- Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and GitHub for file management and version control.
Project Timeline:
This project is expected to be completed within one month.
The hard deadline for delivery is October 1, 2024.
We are looking for a team with the technical expertise and dedication to deliver these features on time. If you are interested and qualified, we look forward to your proposal!

We are seeking a skilled and experienced full-time Shopify Designer/Developer to join our team.Our Brand is called Slouch potato.  We are a Pyjama brand out of AUS www.slouchpotato.comAs a Shopify expert, you will be responsible for coding and designing effective and visually appealing pages for our store. Updating products, updating imagery, helping with weekly site updates.Additionally, your ability to communicate effectively in English will be crucial for collaborating with team members and understanding client requirements. If you are a detail-oriented and creative professional with a passion for e-commerce and a strong understanding of UI/UX principles, we would love to hear from you.Skills required:- Proficiency in Shopify- Strong coding skills- Attention to detail- Excellent communication skills- Knowledge of UI/UX principles

TaskName: WKT-1249 - Implement Three-Stage Service Provider Onboarding Process

data.text: Description
Task Description:
To streamline the onboarding process for service providers joining WorkTok, a three-stage approval system will be implemented as follows:
Stage 1: Initial Submission

items.content: Purpose: This stage captures service providers who have not yet submitted their documentation, those who have refused to accept WorkTok’s policies, or those who need to correct their documentation.
Functionality: Service providers can submit or resubmit their documentation for review. Once submitted, their application will progress to Stage 2 for admin review.

data.text: Stage 2: Documentation Review

items.content: Purpose: At this stage, an admin reviews the submitted documentation.
The admin can either approve the documentation, moving the service provider to Stage 3, or request corrections, which sends the application back to Stage 1.
This stage ensures that all documentation meets WorkTok’s standards before proceeding.

data.text: Stage 3: Final Approval and Onboarding

items.content: Purpose: The final stage involves a direct interaction between the admin and the service provider.
The admin must call the service provider to discuss WorkTok’s policies and confirm their agreement.
If the service provider agrees, the admin can finalize their approval. If not, the service provider is moved back to Stage 1 for further action or rejection.

data.text: Super Admin Controls:

items.content: Super Admin Flexibility: The super admin has the unique ability to move any service provider between Stages 1, 2, and 3 as needed. This functionality allows for correction of errors or re-evaluation of a provider’s application status. This capability is exclusive to the super admin role.

data.text: Notes for Developers:

items.content: Design Integration: Developers should use the Figma design associated with this task to ensure consistency with the overall user interface.

data.text: Checklist:

items.content: Implement the three-stage onboarding process with the defined functionalities.
Ensure that the super admin has the ability to move service providers between stages.
Integrate the Figma design into the development process.
Test the entire workflow to ensure smooth transitions between stages and proper functioning of super admin controls.
Document the changes and update any relevant user guides or training materials.

data.text: Elite E-commerce Website Designer for Luxury Beauty-Tech Brand

Are you a talented e-commerce website designer with a desire to create luxurious and engaging online shopping experiences?We're Nefra, a new and exciting beauty brand inspired by the elegance and mystique of ancient Egypt. We’re looking for a designer who can bring our vision to life with a website that’s truly amazing, captivating, and optimized for sales.What We Need:- A visually stunning, user-friendly e-commerce website that reflects the luxurious nature of our Nefra brand.- Incorporation of 3D models (Optional) and interactive features to engage customers and uniquely showcase our products.- Easy accessibility for quick purchases, including seamless integration of upsell and cross-sell options for bundling our products.- A focus on mobile-friendly design, ensuring the website is fully responsive and provides an exceptional shopping experience on all devices.Our Product Line:We currently have four products:Our main beauty device is the star of our brand. Three complementary products are designed to enhance the effectiveness of the main device.What We're Looking For:- Proven experience in designing e-commerce websites, especially for luxury or beauty brands.- A portfolio that demonstrates your ability to create visually stunning, yet highly functional, e-commerce sites.- Experience with integrating 3D models and interactive elements into websites.- Expertise in designing for conversions, with an understanding of how to guide users through the purchase journey seamlessly.- (Optional) Experience in marketing and social media management, particularly within the UK beauty market, to help attract and engage our target audience.Additional Requirements:Please include the following in your proposal:Expected Timeline:How long do you anticipate the project will take from start to finish?Cost Estimate:A breakdown of your costs and what is included.Deliverables:A clear list of what you will deliver in return, such as the number of web pages, integration of specific features, and post-launch support.Workflow Overview:A brief outline of how the project will progress, including key milestones.Material Needed:A list of what you'll need from us to get started, such as branding guidelines, product images, and content.Why Work With Us?- You’ll have the opportunity to shape the online presence of a brand inspired by the grandeur of ancient Egypt and positioned for success in the modern beauty industry.- We value creativity, innovation, and the ability to think outside the box.- This is a chance to work on a project where your design skills will be showcased to a discerning and high-end audience.If this sounds like the perfect project for you, we’d love to see your portfolio and hear about your experience. Please include examples of your previous work, particularly any projects involving luxury brands, beauty products, or e-commerce.Let’s create something extraordinary together!

TaskName: General | Version Check & Force Update Implementation

checklistArray.name: Set Force Update based on api response

data.text: Implement a feature that compares the app version with the version fetched from an API. If the app version is lower than the API version, display a force update alert to the user.
Requirements:
1. API Integration:

items.content: Fetch the current app version from an external API endpoint
Parse the version response from the API (e.g., version number in the format

data.text: 2. Version Comparison:

items.content: Retrieve the installed app version on the user's device (using platform-specific methods for Android/iOS).
Compare the fetched version from the API with the app’s current version.

data.text: 3. Force Update Logic:

items.content: If the app version is lower than the version from the API, trigger a force update alert.
The alert should prevent the user from continuing to use the app until it is updated.
Provide a button/link to redirect the user to the respective app store (Google Play or Apple App Store) for updating the app.

data.text: 4. Alert Design:

items.content: The alert should contain a clear message.
Include an "Update Now" button that redirects to the app store.

data.text: 5. Edge Cases:

items.content: Handle network errors (e.g., API not reachable) gracefully.
Ensure that the feature works across different versions of Android/iOS.

data.text: Acceptance Criteria:

items.content: The app successfully fetches the latest version from the API.
The app version is compared with the API version on every app launch or when the app returns from the background.
A force update alert is shown if the app version is less than the API version.
Users are redirected to the appropriate app store for the update when clicking the "Update Now" button.
Proper error handling for network issues or unavailable API responses.

data.text: Development of Children's Book E-commerce Website

Project Title:Development of Children's Book E-commerce WebsiteProject Overview:We are looking to create a children's book e-commerce website that will sell curated collections of popular books from well-known publishers, offer personalized books, and provide educational resources. We need a developer to build a user-friendly, visually appealing, and fully functional website that can scale with our growing business.Key Features & Functionality:Home Page:Welcome banner with a brief introduction.Featured collections (New Arrivals, Personalized Books, Educational Favorites).Quick links to popular categories.Customer testimonials and top-rated books.Product Pages:Product listings with sorting and filtering options by age, category, and popularity.Detailed product descriptions, including images, author information, and customer reviews.Personalized book options with fields for customization (child’s name, appearance, etc.)."Related Books" or "Customers Also Bought" suggestions.Shopping Cart & Checkout:Easy-to-use shopping cart with the ability to update quantities, remove items, and apply discount codes.Secure checkout process with multiple payment options (credit card, PayPal, etc.).Option for gift wrapping and personalized gift messages.Integration with a shipping calculator to provide real-time shipping costs.User Account Management:Account creation and login functionality with email verification.User dashboards showing order history, saved items, and tracking information.Option to manage and edit personalized book orders.Reviews & Ratings:Allow users to rate and review products.Display top-rated and most popular books based on user feedback.Interactive Storytime:Integration of a live streaming feature or embedding options for virtual storytime sessions.A calendar feature displaying upcoming storytime events.Option to download related activities or printable content.Reading Challenges & Rewards:Feature to create and track reading challenges for children.Badge or reward system for completed challenges, displayed on the user’s dashboard.Integration with the checkout process to apply rewards as discounts.Personalized Book Recommendations:Algorithm to suggest books based on previous purchases, child’s age, and interests.Option for parents to fill out a profile for more personalized recommendations.Parent & Educator Resource Hub:Dedicated section with downloadable content (reading guides, lesson plans).Blog or article section for educational tips and literacy strategies.Option to sign up for webinars or newsletters.Gift Finder Tool:Interactive tool to help customers find the perfect book based on criteria like age, interests, and occasion.Include an option for gift wrapping and personalized gift messages.Multilingual Book Options:Support for displaying product pages and descriptions in multiple languages.Dropdown menu for language selection.Contact Us Page:Contact form, phone number, email, and physical address.Integration with Google Maps for location display.Social media links.SEO & Analytics:SEO-friendly URLs and meta tags.Integration with Google Analytics and Search Console for performance tracking.CMS Integration:Integration with a Content Management System (CMS) like WordPress or Shopify for easy content updates.Ability to manage products, categories, and content pages from the backend.Responsive Design:Fully responsive design optimized for desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.Fast loading times and smooth user experience across all devices.Security & Compliance:SSL certificate installation for secure transactions.GDPR compliance for user data protection.Regular backups and security patches.Technical Requirements:Platform: WordPress, Shopify, or another suitable e-commerce platform (open to suggestions).Design: Custom design preferred, but open to premium themes that match the brand aesthetic.Development: Clean, maintainable code with comments for future updates.Integrations: Payment gateways, shipping calculators, live chat (optional), email marketing tools (like MailChimp).Testing: Thorough testing across all major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and devices (desktop, tablet, mobile).Deployment: Assist with deployment to the live server and ensure all features are working as expected.Deliverables:Fully functional website with all the features listed above.Documentation on how to manage and update the website.Training session (if necessary) on how to use the CMS and manage products.Ongoing support for a specified period after launch (e.g., 30 days).Budget:$2,000Timeline:4 weeks for the complete project.How to Apply:Submit your portfolio showcasing similar e-commerce websites you've developed.Provide a brief proposal on how you plan to approach this project.Include your estimated timeline and cost.Highlight any additional features or services you can offer.Additional Notes:We are looking for a developer with experience in building e-commerce sites, particularly in the children's product niche.Creativity and attention to detail are key—our brand is all about creating a magical experience for children and parents alike.

description:
Estimated Time (05 hrs)


Every topic in practice is compulsory and create a separate file for every practice


8.1 Date (3hr)

- JavaScript simplifies date and time manipulation through the Date object, a versatile tool for managing temporal information in web applications.


8.1.1 Date Object: (15 min)

- The Date object represents a date and time in JavaScript. You can create a new date object using the new Date() constructor.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date


8.1.2 Get Date Functions: (45 min)

- The Date object has methods to retrieve various aspects of the date and time.

  • getFullYear(): Returns the year.
  • getMonth(): Returns the month (0-11).
  • getDate(): Returns the day of the month.
  • getHours(): Returns the hour.
  • getMinutes(): Returns the minutes.
  • getSeconds(): Returns the seconds.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date


8.1.3 Set Date Function: (45 min)

- The Date object also has methods to set various components of the date and time.

  • setFullYear(year): Sets the year.
  • setMonth(month): Sets the month (0-11).
  • setDate(day): Sets the day of the month.
  • setHours(hours): Sets the hour.
  • setMinutes(minutes): Sets the minutes.
  • setSeconds(seconds): Sets the seconds.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date



8.1.4 Formatting Dates: (45 min)

- Formatting dates in JavaScript often involves constructing a string with the desired format. Libraries like moment.js or the built-in toLocaleString() method can be used for more advanced formatting.


- Example using toLocaleString():- let currentDate = new Date(); let formattedDate = currentDate.toLocaleString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); print the output in console.log(formattedDate ).


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date


8.1.5 Sorting Dates: (30 min)

- To sort an array of dates, you can use the sort() method and provide a custom comparison function.


- Example:- let dateArray = [new Date('2023-01-01'), new Date('2022-12-31'), new Date('2023-02-01')]; dateArray.sort((a, b) => b - a); print the output in console.log(dateArray )


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date



8.2 Debugging (1hr)

- Debugging in JavaScript refers to the process of identifying and fixing errors or bugs in your code. It's an essential skill for developers to ensure their programs run smoothly and produce the expected results. JavaScript provides several tools and techniques for debugging, including:


- Console Logging: Placing console.log() statements at strategic points in your code allows you to print values and messages to the browser console, helping you understand the flow of your program and identify issues.

- Debugger Statement: Placing the debugger; statement in your code will pause execution at that point if the browser's developer tools are open, allowing you to interactively inspect the state of your application.

- Exception Handling: Using try, catch, and throw statements allows you to handle exceptions gracefully and provides an opportunity to log or debug errors without crashing your entire application.

- Linting Tools: Tools like ESLint can help you identify and fix common coding errors and style issues, promoting clean and error-free code.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_debugging.asp
  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/console


8.4 LocalStorage & Session Storage (1hr)

- localStorage: localStorage is a type of web storage that persists even when the browser is closed and reopened. Data stored in localStorage remains available until explicitly cleared by the user or the web application.

- sessionStorage: sessionStorage is similar to localStorage but has a shorter lifespan. Data stored in sessionStorage is accessible only for the duration of the page session. It gets cleared when the page is closed or the browser is restarted.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://javascript.info/localstorage
  • https://www.w3schools.com/jsref/prop_win_localstorage.asp
  • https://www.w3schools.com/jsref/prop_win_sessionstorage.asp

Estimated Time (05hr 10 min)


Practice is compulsory for every topic and creates a separate file for each topic


2.1 Style Guide (30min)

- JavaScript style guide promotes consistent and readable code by emphasizing practices such as 2-space indentation, the use of const for variables, camelCase for naming, and the adoption of ES6 features.


Follow the below link to learn more.

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_conventions.asp
  • https://github.com/airbnb/javascript


2.2 Variables (20min)

- In JavaScript, variables are used to store and manipulate data. They are declared using keywords like var, let, or const. var and let allow for variable reassignment, while const declares a variable with a constant value. Proper naming conventions such as camelCase are encouraged for variables, enhancing code readability.


Follow the below link to learn more 

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_variables.asp
  • https://www.javatpoint.com/javascript-variable


2.3 Variables Data Types (01hr 30min)

- JavaScript supports various data types, including primitive types like numbers, strings, booleans, null, and undefined. Properly leveraging these data types enhances the flexibility and efficiency of your JavaScript applications.

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_datatypes.asp
  • https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/javascript-data-types


2.4 Variables Data Type Conversion (01hr)

- JavaScript automatically performs type conversion, allowing values to be transformed between different data types. This process can be implicit, where JavaScript coerces types during operations, or explicit, using functions like Number(), String(), and Boolean().


Follow the below link to learn more 

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_type_conversion.asp

2.5 JavaScript Operator (01hr 30min)

- JavaScript operators are symbols or keywords that perform operations on operands, such as variables or values. They include arithmetic operators like + and -, comparison operators like === and !==, logical operators such as && and ||, and assignment operators like =.


Follow the below link to learn more

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_operators.asp
  • https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/javascript-operators


2.6 Scope (20min)

- Scope in JavaScript refers to the context in which variables are declared and can be accessed. JavaScript has two main types of scope: global and local. Variables declared outside any function or block have global scope, while those declared within functions or blocks have local scope.

Key elements that need to be included -
1. Before/after photos
2. More human imagery throughout the screenshot set but also include app UI wherever needed
3. Show women with abs/perfectly toned bodies
4. Highlight weight loss programs in in-app screens
App UI - https://www.figma.com/design/3wGcA71kBohbtic8RTyoqe/Consumer-App-UXUI?node-id=1-23&t=rR86CtmvhxHyJRkg-1
(Scroll the pages to find “programs” where you will be able to find the “6 weeks weight loss program” which is the focus of this set)
Brand Guidelines - https://www.figma.com/design/6Cqc1ohT5iQ3DSPLzjOWGI/Consumer-App-GUI?node-id=430-3030&node-type=CANVAS&t=eU3LhsrBXydmPGma-0

Screenshot 1 (With in-app screen)-
Heading: "Kickstart Your Weight Loss Journey"
Visuals:
- Imagery of an inspiring individual, possibly from the waist up, with a confident pose that highlights their fitness journey.
- Overlay of the 6-week weight loss program’s home screen from the app, prominently displaying the "Start Program" button.
Details:
- This screenshot introduces the user to the app’s primary feature—a structured weight loss program. It visually establishes the app as a partner in the user’s weight loss journey.
Screenshot 2 -
Heading: "Visible Results in Just 6 Weeks"
Visuals:
- Before-and-after images of a person, emphasizing the transformation.
Details:
- This screenshot aims to demonstrate the effectiveness of the program by showcasing real user results, driving home the potential for change within a set timeframe.
Screenshot 3 (Make it look like an in-app screen) -
Heading: "Target Stubborn Areas"
Visuals:
- Images focusing on specific areas like belly, thighs, arms, and buttocks - shown as part of the app by creating tiles on a mobile screen
Details:
- This screenshot appeals to users with specific body goals, highlighting how the app helps target and tone stubborn areas, and makes the process clear and actionable.
Screenshot 4 (With in-app screen) -
Heading: "Fun Dance Workout Plans"
Visuals:
- Tiles displaying the multiple dance style options available within the app highlighting - HIIT, salsa, mobility, bollywood, afro, etc.
Details:
- This screenshot shows the flexibility of the app’s program, emphasizing that it can be tailored to fit individual needs while staying focused on weight loss.
Screenshot 5 (With in-app screen) -
Heading: "Dance Off the Pounds"
Visuals:
- An in-app screen highlighting a playlist of high-energy dance workouts specifically designed for maximum calorie burn, with a visible “Calories Burned” tracker.
Details:
- Shows that users can enjoy dancing while burning calories and losing weight. It taps into the idea that weight loss doesn’t have to be grueling—it can be enjoyable and fun.
Screenshot 6 (With in-app screen) -
Heading: "Challenge Yourself Daily"
Visuals:
- In-app screen depicting the program details with week 1, week 2, week 3 plans
Details:
- This screenshot encourages daily engagement.
Screenshot 7 -
Heading: "Achieve Your Dream Body at Home"
Visuals:
- Image of a person dancing in front of a phone/TV while Zumba video is played in the background.
Screenshot 8 (With in-app screen) -
Heading: “You’ve burned 300 calories!”
Visual: Visual of a user with the background of the in-app screen showing a completed program.

Hello!We're an agency looking for someone to help as backup developer for Shopify projects.You'll be helping with different Shopify projects, mostly Figma to Shopify, or making changes to existing shopsWe have a few projects ready to start.Please apply if you have good experience with it and know how to use theme sections to code them to make sections editable in the customizer.Please apply with the words can test today so I understand you read the job post and you're okay with the project.You need to know best practices about CSS also so our existing developers can continue your work and you can continue our developer work.✅The payment for the first 4 weeks is $100/week, after the 4 weeks, it can go up to $150/week✅You need to be available 10am to 6pm London time✅This opportunity is longterm, our team is working already 6 years with Shopify Projects✅You need to have experience with working on multiple small projects per day and reporting in Slack the progress, ask questions, and improve based on feedback, you also have the support of our senior developer✅If you have experience with development of Shopify apps it's a bonus, we have our app and there are some changes needed for it in front end and backend, the app is already liveI have a lot of experience with Shopify projects, I'm a developer myself, so agencies please don't apply, only individuals and don't apply if you want hourly, this is only full time fixed price weekly, the project is a good fit if you're looking for longterm position and not freelancingThanks

data.text: Custom Landing Page Design & Development with Subscription Integration

We are looking for an experienced web designer and developer to create a fully custom landing page integrated with subscription functionality and third-party API integrations. This project requires unique design, seamless functionality, and responsive performance. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in both design and development, as well as experience with API integration, subscription models, and payment gateways.Project Requirements:1. Custom Design:•Design a visually appealing, modern, and responsive landing page that aligns with our brand identity.•Provide initial design mockups and incorporate feedback until approval.•Ensure the page is optimized for both desktop and mobile devices.2. Subscription Integration:•Set up a subscription model (both free and paid options) with multiple tiers.•Integrate payment gateways (e.g., Stripe, PayPal) for secure payment processing.•Ensure smooth functionality and automation of subscription processes (e.g., user management, billing).3. API Integration:•Connect the landing page with third-party APIs to enhance the user experience and automate key processes.•Ensure seamless data flow between systems and the landing page.4. Testing & Optimization:•Fully test the landing page for functionality, responsiveness, and performance.•Provide ongoing support during the testing phase and post-launch to address any issues.5. Launch:•Assist with launching the landing page and ensure everything works smoothly at launch.Type of Project:•One-time projectExpertise/Skills Required:•Custom web design and development•API integration (experience linking third-party services)•Subscription system integration•Payment gateway setup (e.g., Stripe, PayPal)•Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design•Experience with testing and troubleshooting•Familiarity with web performance optimizationLevel of Experience:•Intermediate to Expert

data.text: 1. Main Tagline: "Leading Innovators in Dehydrated Fruits, Vegetables, and Papads" (Center Part)

items.content: Purpose: To immediately grab attention and establish your brand as a leader in the industry.
Design Tip: Use a bold, large font with a contrasting background to ensure readability from a distance.

data.text: 2. Dehydration Process Overview (Center Part)

items.content: Step 1: Sourcing - “High-quality raw fruits and vegetables sourced from trusted farms.”
Step 2: Washing & Cleaning - “Thorough cleaning to ensure safety and hygiene.”
Step 3: Slicing & Preparation - “Precision slicing to retain maximum nutrients.”
Step 4: Dehydration - “Advanced dehydration to lock in nutrients and flavor without preservatives.”
Step 5: Packaging - “Sealed in high-quality aluminium foil bags to maintain freshness.”
Key Points: Use icons for each step (e.g., a leaf for sourcing, water droplet for washing) to make it visually engaging.

data.text: 3. Quality Standards and Certifications (Right Part)

items.content: “Certified by ISO, FSSAI, HACCP – Ensuring world-class quality.”
“Rigorous quality control at every stage to meet international standards.”
“Adherence to food safety protocols to deliver only the best.”
Key Points: Display certification logos to add credibility.

data.text: 4. Packaging Standards (Right Part)

items.content: “Aluminium foil bags – Superior protection against moisture and light.”
“Automated packaging for consistent quality and safety.”
Key Points: Highlight features of the packaging that enhance product longevity and safety.

data.text: 5. Benefits of Dehydrated Products  (Left Part)

items.content: Nutritional Retention: “Retains up to 95% of original vitamins and minerals.”
Long Shelf Life: “Lasts longer without losing quality – perfect for global export.”
Convenience: “Easy to store, lightweight, and ready to use – ideal for any kitchen.”
No Preservatives: “100% natural – no added sugars or artificial preservatives.”
Key Points: Use infographics to visually represent each benefit, such as a clock for shelf life or a heart for nutrition.

data.text: 6. Global Reach and Export Capabilities  (Right Part)

items.content: “Compliant with international food safety and packaging standards.”
“Trusted by global partners for consistent quality and reliability.”
Key Points: A world map with highlighted countries can visually represent your global presence.

This will include creating a unique brand name, a visually striking logo, and a memorable slogan. Our brand emphasizes the efficacy of active ingredients supported by the latest technology, steering clear of industry hype. We aim to empower our customers to be the best version of themselves by offering the best, scientifically-backed products at affordable prices. The ideal candidate will bring our vision of "achieving more with less" into every element of the brand identity.Responsibilities:• Develop a brand name that reflects our commitment to quality and efficacy.• Design a logo that visually communicates our focus on science-based skincare solutions.• Create a slogan that encapsulates our philosophy of empowering individuals through high-quality, effective products.• Collaborate with our team to ensure the brand identity aligns perfectly with our marketing strategies and the needs of our target audience.Requirements:• Proven track record in brand development, with a portfolio showcasing previous work on brand names, logos, and slogans.• Strong understanding of the skincare or beauty industry, particularly insights into African markets.• Fluent in French (ideal) and English, with excellent communication skills to cater effectively to our predominantly Francophone target market.• Ability to work independently, managing creative projects from conception to execution within stipulated deadlines.• Familiarity with cultural nuances that appeal to African and French-speaking audiences.Concept and Target Audience SummaryConcept Summary: Our e-shop is dedicated to distributing top-tier, multi-brand skincare products that are rich in active ingredients and supported by the latest skincare technology. We focus on product efficacy over marketing hype, empowering our users to achieve the best version of themselves with minimalistic yet effective solutions. Our objective is to deliver exceptional value through products that truly work, sourced from the best currently available on the market, and offered at an affordable price.Target Audience: Professional women aged 30-50 in Côte d'Ivoire and across West Africa who prioritize quality, scientifically supported skincare. They seek effective solutions tailored to their skin needs, delivered in a straightforward and accessible manner.Hiring Criteria1. Portfolio Excellence: Evaluating creativity and effectiveness in previous branding projects, especially in relevant sectors.2. Skincare Industry Acumen: Preferential consideration for candidates with a background in beauty or skincare, indicating a deep understanding of product efficacy and consumer needs.3. Cultural Insight: Strong grasp of cultural elements significant to African and Francophone markets, ensuring the brand resonates well with the target demographic.4. Language Proficiency: French language skills are highly desirable for effectively engaging with the target market.5. Client Testimonials: Positive feedback from previous engagements, highlighting reliability, innovation, and client satisfaction.Attached mood broad : chic, minimalist, African boho

data.text: High-End Website Designer Needed for Sleek, Premium E-commerce Site (Similar to LARQ or Apple)

Job Description:I am looking for a highly skilled web designer to build a premium e-commerce website for my brand, LUMN. The website should have a sleek, modern, and minimalist design, similar to LARQ or Apple. This will be the primary platform for selling our innovative UV self-cleaning water bottles, so the site needs to reflect a luxury brand aesthetic while ensuring a seamless shopping experience.Key Responsibilities:• Design and develop a responsive e-commerce website that works across all devices (mobile, tablet, desktop).• Build a clean, modern UI that aligns with the LUMN brand’s minimalist and tech-forward aesthetic.• Implement e-commerce functionality such as product pages, shopping cart, checkout, and payment gateway integration.• Ensure the site is optimized for SEO and fast loading speeds.• Create custom product pages with high-quality images, smooth animations, and a focus on the bottle’s key features (e.g., UV self-cleaning technology).• Optimize the website for mobile-first design and ensure it is easy to navigate on all devices.• Provide post-launch support and be available for ongoing updates as needed.Required Skills:• Proven experience designing premium e-commerce websites (portfolio required).• Proficiency in platforms like Shopify or WordPress (depending on the preferred platform).• Expertise in UX/UI design to ensure a seamless and user-friendly experience.• Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript (for any custom functionalities or animations).• Strong understanding of SEO best practices and ability to integrate tools like Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, etc.• Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively.Timeline:The project should take 1 to 3 months to complete. We aim to launch the website shortly after development is finished.Budget:This will be a fixed-price project, and the budget can be negotiated based on experience and portfolio. I am looking for someone who can deliver a high-quality website with a professional look and feel.

data.text: Shopify Developer for Start Up Supplement Brand

We're looking for a Shopify Developer to join us to build a new subcription supplement's brand website. We will do the design and finesse the wireframes - you will do the build.There will be some complexities -Parallax Scrolling: They want a visually dynamic effect where elements remain fixed or scroll at different speeds, creating depth and a 3D-like feel as the user navigates the site.Personalised Cart/Quiz Interaction: A custom quiz that not only collects customer information but also dynamically builds a personalised cart. The cart should be customisable based on preset rules, such as a minimum of three sachets per week and certain conditional responses in the quiz that adjust the cart (e.g., answering "yes" to a question would add two sachets to the weekly bundle).Building bundles: In addition to the quiz, customers are to have the option to build their own bundles without going through the quiz process—similar to the flexibility seen on vitable.com.au.The site will need certain Shopify plugins, such as CartonCloud. Klaviyo, as well as other essential tools. At the end of the quiz, we need the system to automatically create a customer account, recording all of the information they entered. This will be crucial not only for record-keeping but also for gathering data to refine our future products and improve customer experience.

TaskName: WKT-1203 - Improving Push Notification Tab for WorkTok Admin Dashboard

data.text: Description
Use case

items.content: We need to improve the push notification feature on the WorkTok admin dashboard. The new functionality should allow the admin to select the target audience for the notifications, with the following specifications.

data.text: Scope

items.content: This CRM system will help the Admin, marketing, and Ops team to push strategies through push notifications.

data.text: Requirements

items.content: All Users: The admin should be able to send notifications to all users who have downloaded the app.
Service Providers Only: If selected, the admin can further filter the audience based on:
Documentation Status (e.g., documentation submitted, approved, needs correction)
Job Activity (e.g., number of jobs done, not done a job yet)
Customers Only: If selected, the admin can further filter the audience based on:
Job Activity (e.g., did a job, not done a job yet)
Date of Joining or Date Range Selection.
Admin should be able to write the content of the push notification, with support for emojis.
Admin should be able to send the notification immediately or schedule it for a specific date and time.
Admin should be able to view all scheduled notifications, with options to edit, reschedule, or delete them.
After applying filters, the admin should see the number of users who will receive the notification.
Admin should have the option to select specific users (service providers or customers) based on:

data.text: Deliverables

items.content: Implement the option for admins to select audience categories (All Users, Service Providers, Customers).

Ensure filtering options are available for Service Providers (zone, category, status, documentation status, registration status, job activity, featured status, coins, subscription status, and transaction amount).
Ensure filtering options are available for Customers (registration status, job activity, transaction amount, gender).
Add the date of joining and date range selection filters.
Design the interface for writing push notifications with emoji support.
Implement scheduling options for push notifications.
Design a dashboard for viewing, editing, rescheduling, or deleting of scheduled notifications.

We are a startup in the fitness and supplement industry, focused on creating a high-quality products for hybrid athletes.We're seeking an experienced web designer and developer who can help us refine and build a visually appealing and high-converting e-commerce website on Shopify. This role involves working on everything from design tweaks to advanced Shopify app development and integrating various APIs to optimize the store’s performance and enhance customer experience.Responsibilities:- Customize and enhance the functionality of our existing Shopify store.- Build and implement new Shopify apps, integrations, and plugins as required.- Optimize the store’s performance, loading speed, and mobile responsiveness.- Develop and implement advanced features to improve the customer shopping experience.- Ensure seamless integration of third-party apps, payment gateways, and tracking tools (including Google Ads tracking).- Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Shopify themes, plugins, and code.- Work closely with our marketing and sales teams to ensure the website aligns with business goals.- Implement SEO best practices and integrate tools for improving search visibility.- Regularly update and maintain the Shopify store.Requirements:- Proven experience as a Shopify Developer with a portfolio of successful Shopify projects (preferably in the furniture or home goods niche).- Strong understanding of Shopify’s platform, themes, and liquid programming language.- Experience with Shopify APIs, app integrations, and custom development.- Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery.- Knowledge of e-commerce best practices, UX/UI principles, and SEO optimization.- Familiarity with Shopify Plus is a plus.- Ability to troubleshoot and solve complex coding issues.- Strong communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setting.Nice to Have:- Experience working with furniture or home goods e-commerce stores.- Familiarity with Google Ads tracking setup and optimization in Shopify.- Understanding of performance optimization for large product catalogs.If you're passionate about Shopify development and eager to contribute to a growing outdoor furniture brand, we want to hear from you! Please send your resume, portfolio, and a brief cover letter detailing your Shopify experience.

subscriptions (skip weeks, adjust preferences, cancel, etc.).Set up secure payment processing with Shopify’s payment gateway or others as needed.Create a user-friendly, mobile-responsive design that reflects our brand identity.Implement an intuitive backend dashboard for easy management of meal plans, subscriptions, and customer data.Optimize the site for speed and SEO.Provide post-launch support for minor adjustments and updates.Requirements:Proven experience with Shopify development, including customization and integrations.Familiarity with meal subscription models and the tools used to manage recurring orders.Experience with subscription apps like Recharge or Bold Subscriptions.Expertise in frontend development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and UX/UI design.Ability to integrate third-party apps (e.g., customer reviews, referral programs).Strong communication skills and the ability to provide regular project updates.Portfolio showcasing relevant Shopify projects (meal subscription websites a plus).Bonus Skills:Experience with meal delivery services or food-related businesses.Knowledge of digital marketing strategies (SEO, email automation) within Shopify.Familiarity with Caribbean food and culture.Timeline: We’re aiming to launch the website in the next 4-6 weeks.Budget: Open to negotiation based on experience and scope of work.How to Apply: description:
https://infinum.com/handbook/qa/tools/using-chrome-dev-tools


Chrome DevTools is a set of web development tools built directly into the Google Chrome browser. These tools provide developers with powerful debugging and diagnostic capabilities, making it easier to build, test, and optimize web applications. DevTools allows you to inspect the DOM, monitor network activity, debug JavaScript, analyze performance, and much more


Purpose of Chrome DevTools

The primary purpose of Chrome DevTools is to facilitate the development, debugging, and optimization of web applications. Key functions include:


  1. Inspecting and Modifying the DOM: DevTools allows developers to view and edit the Document Object Model (DOM) and the corresponding styles (CSS). This helps in real-time editing and troubleshooting of the layout and design of web pages.
  2. Debugging JavaScript: DevTools includes a powerful JavaScript debugger that allows developers to set breakpoints, step through code, and inspect the state of the application. This makes it easier to find and fix bugs in the code.
  3. Monitoring Network Activity: The Network panel provides insights into the resources loaded by the web page, including timing information, size, and status codes. This is crucial for optimizing load times and diagnosing network-related issues.
  4. Performance Profiling: The Performance panel helps developers analyze the performance of their applications by recording runtime performance data. This includes CPU and memory usage, frame rates, and more.
  5. Security and Application Audits: DevTools provides tools for auditing the security of the application, such as checking for mixed content or security misconfigurations. It also includes Lighthouse for performance, accessibility, and SEO audits.
  6. Mobile Emulation: Developers can simulate different device viewports and network conditions to test how their applications perform on mobile devices.

brew install git

data.text: Expert Website Designer & Full Stack Developer (Figma, WordPress, Shopify)

Job Description:We are an established digital agency looking to hire a top-tier Website Designer and Full Stack Developer to join our team on a long-term basis. This role will require a combination of design expertise using Figma and robust development skills, primarily in WordPress, but also across Shopify, Webflow, and BigCommerce as needed.The ideal candidate will have a strong design background with the ability to craft visually compelling and user-friendly websites. Additionally, they should be proficient in full theme customization, plugin development, and deployment on WordPress, with the flexibility to work on other platforms.Key Responsibilities:• Design high-quality, responsive, and user-centered website layouts and interfaces in Figma.• Develop, customize, and maintain WordPress themes and plugins.• Handle end-to-end website deployment and ensure websites are optimized for performance.• Collaborate on projects involving Shopify, Webflow, and BigCommerce as required, adapting to platform-specific needs.• Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade websites as needed to maintain functionality and improve user experience.• Provide ongoing support and maintenance for multiple websites.• Communicate effectively with our team to ensure projects are delivered on time and meet the agency’s standards.Requirements:• Proven experience in website design using Figma and full-stack development on WordPress.• Solid proficiency in WordPress theme customization, plugin development, and website deployment.• Experience with Shopify, Webflow, and BigCommerce is a must.• Strong understanding of front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and back-end skills (PHP, MySQL).• Ability to create responsive and visually appealing designs that align with project requirements and client expectations.• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.• Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.• Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with team members and adapt to agency workflows.Preferred Qualifications:• Prior experience working with agencies or in a remote team environment.• Familiarity with other website platforms and tools as our projects may evolve.• A portfolio showcasing previous work on Figma, WordPress, and other platforms listed.First Milestone:Milestone 1: Discovery Phase - $1,200 USD• Conduct project planning to define objectives, deliverables, and timelines for the design, development, and deployment of two websites.• Gather insights, research user needs, and finalize design preferences for both websites.• Create a detailed project roadmap and break down the project into subsequent milestones to cover Figma design, WordPress development, and final deployment.This initial milestone is part of a larger project, which includes the design and development of two websites on Figma and WordPress. For the right candidate, this is an opportunity for ongoing, long-term collaboration on multiple projects.

Job Overview: We are seeking a skilled and experienced Shopify Expert to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for setting up, optimizing, and managing our Shopify store. This role involves creating a seamless online shopping experience by listing products, designing and customizing the store, and implementing strategies to drive sales. If you have a deep understanding of Shopify, e-commerce best practices, and the ability to build and maintain a high-performing online store, we want to hear from you.Key Responsibilities:Shopify Store Setup: Configure and launch our Shopify store, including setting up the company profile, payment gateways, shipping methods, and store policies.Product Listing: Add and organize products with accurate descriptions, images, prices, and inventory tracking.Store Customization: Design and customize the Shopify store layout, ensuring a user-friendly, aesthetically pleasing, and responsive design across all devices.Sales Optimization: Implement sales strategies, discounts, and promotions to maximize revenue.App Integration: Set up and manage third-party Shopify apps to enhance store functionality, including marketing tools, analytics, and customer service plugins.SEO & Performance Optimization: Ensure the store is optimized for search engines (SEO) and delivers a fast, smooth shopping experience.Sales Management: Oversee daily store operations, manage orders, returns, and customer inquiries to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.Data Analysis: Track and report on sales performance, customer behavior, and website traffic to drive improvements in sales and conversions.Ongoing Maintenance: Perform routine updates and improvements to ensure the store is running smoothly and remains aligned with business goals.Qualifications:Proven experience in setting up and managing Shopify stores.Expertise in Shopify’s platform and its apps, themes, and tools.Strong knowledge of product listing and store design principles.Experience with e-commerce strategies for driving sales and customer engagement.Basic understanding of SEO and web analytics.Knowledge of Shopify integrations, including payment gateways, shipping solutions, and marketing tools.Excellent attention to detail, time management, and problem-solving skills.Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.Preferred Qualifications:Experience in e-commerce and digital marketing.Familiarity with Shopify Liquid for advanced customizations.Knowledge of online retail and customer behavior trends.Working Hours: Available to work full-time or part-time, with flexibility based on project timelines and business needs.

data.text: I am looking for someone who will be able to create page mockups on Figma, then implement those designs on WordPress using page builders (most commonly Gutenberg, but sometimes WPBakery/Visual Composer), and be able to implement frontend tweaks from a JS/CSS level above what standard editor functionality will allow.

It's essentially taking ownership of the design process, from concept to implementation. You will be provided design requirements and specifics (where they're known, e.g. sample sites or intended looks) and turn those into figma then iterate then implement then tweak, adding in your insights and design sense along the way.

Ideally you're able to think outside the box (doesn't mean design weird stuff but sometimes as well), mainly in the sense of understanding the objectives of the site and what works well (not only looks good) to e.g. aim visitors to a specific outcome.

Bringing more of the design side to it is a pro (e.g. being able to design graphics on the micro side of it, to having a more cohesive overall design sense in the macro), of course you'll also be responsible for implementing what you design as well.

This will be for a mix of ecommerce (woocommerce) where shop pages will need to be designed, as well as informational (i.e. "standard") pages.Attention to detail is important, and while there will be separate QC involved, you'll be expected to consider consistency (fonts, spacing, colors, etc.) in your finished product.

So that I know we're on the same page - since this is a combination role of designing, using page builders, and HTML/CSS/JS coding when required - please begin your message with the following statement: "My skillset is definitely well-suited for both implementation & design; I have [no/little/average/significant] experience with designing where WooCommerce is involved, and the one page builder I am most experienced in is: [X]." Please fill in "X" as appropriate, and as a matter of attention to detail, please (a) keep the square brackets around it, but (b) when selecting your level of experience with WooCommerce, choose only the option that applies to you, delete the other three (along with the square brackets), but keep the forward slashes.

data.text: We are looking for someone who is experienced in WCFM, WOO and DIVI, to bring our project forward. We like to refer to Reverb.com and Etsy.com as good design/organization models (though we do not want to be a clone!). We are still pre-launch and would like to complete this phase by year end, if possible.

Our Multi-Vendor music-instrument marketplace has been built with DIVI, and integrates both WCFM and WooCommerce, as well as a number of plugins such as ACF and others.. Most of the design is completed, but certain pieces must still be refined or ironed out over several project modules.

This is not our first project - we have experience hiring and working with UPWORK vendors. Most items listed below are pretty small but we realize that some of the items listed will require more work. We will further clarify the descriptions below and answer any of your questions as we move forward:
WooCommerce Module:
Product images - Magnifier is WONKY. Should work like ETSY or REVERB: (Click to see larger image, then use arrows to move through pics)
Filenames appear with images after magnified and must be removed.
LOGIN-Register-Sign-in Buttons are grayed (invisible), user must be able to SUBMIT.
Register / Vendor Form - USER REGISTRATION is CLUNKY. Should be more like ETSY/REVERB.
Enable Sign-in with Google. Remove right column on Select Membership page.
Product / Inventory needs additional selection “No longer available”
Seller Add Product Form - Cats & Attributes need redesign like REVERB. Currently using Advanced Custom Forms, but needs better/more sensible integration.
My-Account: Needs Better Layout/Design
Ability to upload bulk product listings
Several Text/language changes/corrections.
WCFM Module:
WCFM TEXT ERRORSVendor Membership needs minor text edit
REGISTRATION needs minor text edit
Vendor Membership Plans page needs minor text edit
Vendor Membership Plans Page - possible Page redesign
Remove Image above each storefront
GENERAL/Misc:
PayPal Gateway Integration
Site Performance needs improvement
Possible WC/Google SEO Work
You must be fluent in English and be available to communicate during normal hours, US Eastern Time. We enjoy communicating and look forward to exploring your thoughtful suggestions. Thank you!

- This is an ongoing position for website maintenance and improvements as needed.

• Monthly performance reports with actionable insights.

data.text: We are looking for a skilled front-end developer to refine our website’s design, improve responsiveness, and ensure a seamless user experience across both mobile and desktop platforms. The developer will also ensure the visual aesthetics and interactive elements are polished, ensuring a smooth user journey for both service providers and customers.
Responsibilities:
• Review and improve the overall UI/UX of the website.
• Optimize and refine all pages for mobile and desktop responsiveness.
• Fix inconsistencies in design elements such as fonts, colors, padding, and margins across different devices.
• Ensure all interactive components such as buttons, sliders, forms, and animations function smoothly on both desktop and mobile.
• Polish the front-end design to enhance user engagement and make the site visually appealing.
• Work closely with the back-end developer to ensure front-end elements are properly integrated and aligned with the backend functionality.
• Test across multiple browsers and devices to ensure full compatibility and responsiveness.
Required Skills:
• Strong experience with WordPress themes (preferably Woodmart) and custom CSS.
• Expertise in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design.
• Proficiency with mobile-first design principles.
• Experience with Elementor or other page builders for WordPress.
• Ability to fix and polish both design and functionality issues.
• Familiarity with UX/UI best practices for enhancing user interaction and conversion.
Preferred Skills:
• Experience with marketplaces or booking platforms.
• Knowledge of mobile and desktop optimization techniques.
• Familiarity with WordPress performance optimization for faster load times.
